p-216.principle: Natural frequency-ga qaabka daaqaddu waa $f=\frac{1}{2\pi}\sqrt{\frac{k}{m}}$. Haddii frequency-ga isbeddelka dabayshu $f$ la mid noqdo, resonance ayaa dhacda oo si weyn ayay u gariiraan. Buffer-ku wuxuu ku daraa damping oo wuxuu beddelaa stiffness $k$ si resonance looga fogaado.
p-216.example: Haddii daaqad 8kg ah $k=80\ \mathrm{kN/m}$ lagu taageero, $f=\frac{1}{2\pi}\sqrt{80000/8}\approx15.9\ \mathrm{Hz}$. Haddii buffer-ku $k$ 2 jibaar ka dhigo, wuxuu kor u kacaa ku dhawaad 22.5Hz, damping-na wuu kordhaa oo ruxruxu wuu yaraadaa. Haddii farqiga la xidho, hawada qabow ee jiilaalka way yaraataa oo tamarta kululaynta ayaa la badbaadin karaa.
p-216.actionItem: Farqiga qaabka daaqadda ku dheji weatherstrip buffer dhumucdiisu 5~10mm oo hubi inuu codka ruxruxa yareeyo.

p-217.title: Maxay sababta tarp-ka kaambaha uu dabayshu u kor qaadayso
p-217.summary: Dabayl si degdeg ah tarp-ka dushiisa maraysa wuxuu yareeyaa cadaadiska oo maradii kor ayuu u qaadaa, sidaas darteed maalmaha dabayshu xoogga badan tahay habka tarp-ka loo xidho ayaa go'aamiya badbaadada.
p-217.principle: Mabda'a Bernoulli ee cadaadisku hooseeyo meesha xawaaraha dareeruhu sarreeyo, farqiga cadaadiska sare iyo hoose waa $\Delta P\approx\frac{1}{2}\rho v^2$. Farqigan cadaadiska ayaa noqda lift-ka maradii kor u qaada.
p-217.example: Xawaaraha dabayshu 10m/s $\Delta P\approx\frac{1}{2}\times1.225\times10^2\approx61\ \mathrm{Pa}$ tarp 4m×4m (16m²) ah xoog ugu badnaan ku dhawaad 980N (ku dhawaad 100 kgf) ayaa ku dhici kara. Xawaaraha 20m/s waa 4 jibaar.
p-217.actionItem: Marka tarp la gadanayo, eeg tirada eyelet-yada iyo xaaladda xoojinta, marka la dhisayo, dhinaca hoose u jeedi jihada dabayshu oo peg-ka si qalloocan oo qoto dheer ugu dhufo.

p-218.title: Intaadan demin air conditioner-ka, 10 daqiiqo fan mode
p-218.summary: Haddii intaadan demin air conditioner-ka 10 daqiiqo ku shaqeeyo fan mode, huurta gudaha way qalalaysaa, ur caaryo way yaraataa, kharashka koronto-na ma kordho.
p-218.principle: Qabowga kadib evaporator-ka waxaa ku hara dhibco biyo ah oo condensation ah. Xawaaraha uumi-baxu wuxuu u dhigmaa farqiga cadaadiska uumiga saturated iyo cadaadiska uumiga dhabta $(p_s-p)$, haddii hawo qoyan fan-ku riixo si dhaqso ah ayuu u qalalaa.
p-218.example: Awoodda fan mode waa ku dhawaad 40W, 10 daqiiqo waa $40\times\frac{10}{60}\approx6.7\ \mathrm{Wh}$ oo keliya. Haddii huurta harto caaryo iyo bakteeriya ayaa kordha oo ur ayaa yimaada, waxayna keeni kartaa kharash nadiifin air conditioner iyo hoos u dhac waxqabad.
p-218.actionItem: Maanta intaadan demin air conditioner-ka, 10 daqiiqo ku shaqeeyo fan ama dry mode, ama haddii uu leeyahay auto-dry ka shid.

p-219.title: Duullimaadka turbulence-ka, had iyo jeer suunka xidh
p-219.summary: Turbulence-ku wuu imanayaa digniin la'aan, sidaas darteed marka la fadhiyo had iyo jeer suunka badbaadada xidhidda waa habka ugu hubaasha badan ee looga hortago dhaawac.
p-219.principle: Sharciga labaad ee Newton $F=ma$ marka diyaaraddu si toosan dardar degdeg ah u hesho, jidhka sidoo kale isla dardar ayaa ku shaqeeya. Haddii dardarka toosan $\pm1\,g$ yahay culeyska muuqdaa wuxuu noqdaa 0 ama 2 jibaar.
p-219.example: Qof 70kg ah xitaa turbulence dhexdhexaad ah ee $\pm0.5\,g$ wuxuu helaa isbeddel xoog ku dhawaad $0.5\times70\times9.8\approx343\ \mathrm{N}$. Turbulence xoog badan oo 1g ka badan, qofka suunka xidhnayn wuxuu ka kori karaa kursiga oo saqafka ku dhici karaa.
p-219.actionItem: Marka duulimaadka kursiga la fadhiyo, suunka badbaadada si jidhka ku habboon ayaa hoosta xudunta lagu xidhaa.

p-220.title: Gaariga biyuhu qarqay albaabkiisu ma furmo
p-220.summary: Albaabka gaariga biyuhu qarqay sababta cadaadiska biyaha ma furmo, sidaas darteed daaqadda ayaa degdeg looga baxaa, ma aha albaabka.
p-220.principle: Xoogga biyuhu albaabka saaraan waa $F=\rho g\frac{h}{2}A$ oo ah cadaadiska qoto-dheeraanta celceliska ee lagu dhufto aagga. Ilaa heerka biyaha gudaha iyo dibadda albaabku isu simmanaado, waa in xoogan lagu furaa.
p-220.example: Albaab ballaadhkiisu 1.0m, heerka biyuhu 0.5m (aag 0.5m²) $F=1000\times9.8\times0.25\times0.5\approx1225\ \mathrm{N}$ ku dhawaad 125 kgf. Daaqadaha korontadu dhawaan way joogsan karaan. Intaan biyuhu buuxin, marka ay bilaabayaan inay quusaan isla markiiba dhaqaaq.
p-220.actionItem: Gaariga gudihiisa ku hay dubbe baxsad degdeg ah (qalab jebinta daaqadda) meel gacantaada ka dhow, oo wadooyinka biyuhu qarqeen ha gelin.

p-221.title: Marka onkodku dhawaaqo, fiilooyinka qalabka guriga ka jar
p-221.summary: Onkodka waqtigiisa danab aad u sarreeya (surge) ayaa isla markiiba ku dhex ururaa fiilooyinka, taas oo kharribi kartaa TV-ga iyo kombuyuutarka, sidaas darteed intaan onkodku dhawaaqin plug-yada ka jar.
p-221.principle: Marka korontada onkodku si degdeg ah u isbeddesho, fiilooyin goobaabban oo u dhow ayaa danab $V=-M\frac{dI}{dt}$ ku kora ($M$ waa mutual inductance). Marka isbeddelka korontadu weyn yahay kV dhowr ayaa soo baxa.
p-221.example: $M=1\ \mathrm{\mu H}$ iyo $dI/dt=6\times10^9\ \mathrm{A/s}$ $V\approx6\ \mathrm{kV}$ wuxuu dhaafayaa 1.5~2.5kV oo qalabka guriga 220V ay u adkeystaan. Laakiin marka onkodku si toos ah madaxaaga ka dusha ku dhaco, ha u dhowaan inaad plug-ka ka jarto.
p-221.actionItem: Intaanay duufaanku iman, TV-ga, kombuyuutarka iyo router-ka ka jar ama isticmaal surge protector, marka onkodku dhawaaqo fiilooyinka iyo qalabka ha taaban.

p-222.title: Dhirta balakoonka duufaanka kahor gudaha geli
p-222.summary: Dhir ama alaab duufaanku duuliyay ama ka dhacday waxay dhimasho u keeni kartaa dadka hoos ku sugan, sidaas darteed dhirta balakoonka iyo alaabta hore gudaha u geli.
p-222.principle: Tamarta walaxda ka dhacaysa dherer $h$ waa $mgh$, xawaaraha dhicitaanka haddii iska caabbinta hawada la dayo waa $v=\sqrt{2gh}$. Khatarku wuxuu kordhaa isla culeyska iyo dhererka.
p-222.example: Dhir 5kg ah oo ka dhacda ku dhawaad 30m dherer (dabaq 10) waa $v\approx24\ \mathrm{m/s}$ (ku dhawaad 87km saacaddii) tamartuna waa ku dhawaad $5\times9.8\times30\approx1470\ \mathrm{J}$. Tani waxay la mid tahay tamarta walax 3.8kg ah oo ku duulaysa ku dhawaad 100km saacaddii.
p-222.actionItem: Marka saadaasha duufaanka la shaaciyo, dhirta, qalabka dharka lagu qalo iyo alaabta yar yar ee balakoonka gudaha geli oo daaqadaha xidh.

p-223.title: Dhaan-dhaanta doonnida waa ka yar tahay bartamaha lakabka hoose
p-223.summary: Bartamaha doonnida iyo lakabka hoose ruxruxa ayaa ugu yar, sidaas darteed dhaan-dhaanta way yartahay, marka qolka ama kursiga la doorto halkan dooro.
p-223.principle: Doonnidu waxay ku ruxmaan agagaarka xarunta, sidaas darteed cabbirka dhaqdhaqaaqa goobtu wuxuu u dhigmaa masaafada xarunta wareegga ($s\approx r\theta$). Marka isbeddelka indhuhu arkaan iyo dareenka vestibular-ka dhegta ay isku si ahayn, dhaan-dhaanta ayaa dhacda.
p-223.example: Marka ruxruxa dhinaca $\pm2^\circ$ (0.035 rad), hore-u-dhaca doonnida 40m xarunta ka fog waa ku dhawaad $\pm1.4\ \mathrm{m}$, bartamaha 5m ka fog ku dhawaad $\pm0.17\ \mathrm{m}$ ayuu dhaqaaqaa, farqiga 8 jibaar. Lakabka sare ayaa ruxruxu ka sii weyn yahay.
p-223.actionItem: Marka doonni la qorsheynayo, dooro qol ku yaal lakabka hoose ee bartamaha jidhka doonnida, ka dib marka lagu soo dhoofo, xariiqda cirka eeg.

p-224.title: Xiddigaha dhaca waxaa la arkaa 20 daqiiqo kadib marka indhuhu mugdiga la qabsadaan
p-224.summary: Marka meel iftiin leh laga baxo si loo arko xiddigaha dhaca, indhuhu waxay u baahan yihiin ku dhawaad 20~30 daqiiqo si ay mugdiga ugu qabsadaan, intaas ka hor meteoroyada daciifka ah si fiican looma arko.
p-224.principle: Mugdiga gudihiisa rod cells-ku way dareemi karaan iftiinka oo photopigment-ka ayaa dib u soo noqda, iftiinka ugu yar ee la arki karaa si weyn ayuu hoos ugu dhacaa waqtiga. Qabsashada buuxda ee rod cells waxay qaadataa ku dhawaad 20~30 daqiiqo, iftiinka shaashadda taleefanka ayaa baabi'iya qabsashada.
p-224.example: Marka mugdiga la qabsado, dareenka iftiinka wuxuu noqdaa ku dhawaad 10,000 jibaar ka badan meelaha iftiinka leh. Perseid meteor shower-ku wuxuu gaaraa ugu sarreeyntiisa 12~13 Ogosto sannad kasta, meelaha dayaxa iyo nalalka magaalada ay yar yihiin waxaa laga arki karaa tobanaan saacaddii.
p-224.actionItem: Marka xiddigaha dhaca la arkaayo, meel ugu mugdi badan 20 daqiiqo ha eegin taleefanka, oo cirka si ballaaran u eeg.

p-225.title: Maxay sababta shaashadda aan loo arki karin duhurkii dibadda, iftiinka iyo milicsiga
p-225.summary: Dibadda iftiinka badan shaashadda ma muuqato ma aha inay mugdi tahay, laakiin iftiinka qorraxda ee dusha shaashadda milicsadaa ayaa daboolaya iftiinka shaashadda.
p-225.principle: Contrast ratio waa $CR=\frac{L+L_a}{L_a}$, $L$ waa iftiinka shaashadda (nit), $L_a=\frac{RE}{\pi}$ waa iftiinka ambient-ka ee dusha milicsadaa ($R$ milicsiga, $E$ illuminance). Marka iftiinka la milicsaday weynaado contrast ratio wuxuu ku dhowaadaa 1.
p-225.example: Qorraxda toosa $E=100{,}000\ \mathrm{lx}$, milicsiga $R=2\%$ marka $L_a\approx637\ \mathrm{nit}$. Shaashadda 800 nit $CR\approx(800+637)/637\approx2.3$:1 ma muuqato, qolka 300 lx $L_a\approx1.9\ \mathrm{nit}$ $CR$ waa boqolaal.
p-225.actionItem: Maalmaha qorraxdu xoogga badan tahay, iftiinka shaashadda ugu badan ama auto dhig, oo jidhka ama gacanta ku samee hoos shaashadda.

p-226.title: Maxay sababta compass-ka khariidada safarku u khaldamo
p-226.summary: Compass-ka taleefanku wuxuu akhrinayaa goobta magnetic-ga ah ee dhulka ee daciifka ah, sidaas darteed magnet ama bir u dhow ayaa si fudud u khaldi karta jihada.
p-226.principle: Goobta magnetic-ga ah ee dhulku waa ku dhawaad $50\ \mu\mathrm{T}$ (aagga Kuuriya) oo aad u daciif ah, marka goobta magnetic-ga ah ee $B_{int}$ ee walxaha magnetic-ga ah ee agagaarka ayaa lagu daro, qalad jiho ayaa yimaada $\theta\approx\arctan\frac{B_{int}}{B_{earth}}$.
p-226.example: Daboolka magnet-ka ama gaadhiga taageeraha $10\ \mu\mathrm{T}$ oo keliya ayaa lagu daraa qaladku waa $\arctan(10/50)\approx11^\circ$. Intaas ka sokow, Kuuriya waxay leedahay declination ku dhawaad 8° oo ka dhexeeya waqooyiga magnetic-ga iyo waqooyiga dhabta ah, sidaas darteed farqiga waqooyiga khariidada iyo waqooyiga magnetic-ga ayaa la tixgeliyaa.
p-226.actionItem: Haddii app-ka khariidadu jihada si cajiib ah u muujiyo, taleefanka qaabka 8 ku wareeji si compass-ka loo calibrate-gareeyo, oo ka fogow magnet iyo bir.

p-227.title: Buur kasta oo 100m la fuulo, heerkulku wuxuu hoos u dhacaa 0.65 digrii
p-227.summary: Buuraha dhaadheer waxay aad uga qabow yihiin dhulka siman isla maalinta, sidaas darteed haddii dharka loo diyaariyo kuleylka dhulka siman oo keliya, buurta dushiisa waa qabow.
p-227.principle: Heerkulka jawigu wuxuu hoos u dhacaa marka dhererku kordho celceliska lapse rate $\Gamma\approx6.5\ ^\circ\mathrm{C/km}$. Marka farqiga dhererku $\Delta z$ yahay, heerkulku wuxuu isbeddelaa $\Delta T=-\Gamma\Delta z$.
p-227.example: Haddii meesha laga bilaabo 100m heer-badeed 30°C tahay, Cheonwangbong ee Jirisan (1915m) waa $30-0.65\times18.15\approx18.2\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. Haddii dabayl jirto heerkulka la dareemo ayaa sii hooseeya.
p-227.actionItem: Intaadan buur aadin, saadaasha ka hubi heerkulka dushiisa, oo jaakad dabayl-celinta fudud geli boorsada dhabarka.

p-228.title: Habeenka kulul (tropical night), derbiyadu waxay kuleylka maalinta kaydiyay habeenkii sii daayaan
p-228.summary: Habeenada kulul kuleylka waxaa keena kuleylka derbiyada iyo dhulka maalinta ku kaydsamay oo habeenkii mar kale soo baxa, sidaas darteed maalinta qorraxda xannib habeenkiina hawo-geli.
p-228.principle: Walxaha kuleylka kaydiya sida concrete wuxuu kaydiyaa kuleyl $Q=mc\Delta T$ marka heerkulku kordho, marka gudaha qabowdo kuleylkaas ayuu sii daayaa. Marka mass-ka iyo specific heat-ku weyn yihiin kaydintuna way weyn tahay.
p-228.example: Derbi concrete ah oo dhumucdiisu 20cm, aagguna 10m² (mass ku dhawaad 4800kg, specific heat ku dhawaad 0.88kJ/(kg·K)) oo 5°C kordhaya wuxuu kaydiyaa $Q\approx4800\times0.88\times5\approx21\ \mathrm{MJ}$ (ku dhawaad 5.9kWh). Kuleylkani habeenka oo dhan si tartiib ah ayuu qolka ugu soo baxaa.
p-228.actionItem: Maalinta daaqadaha qorraxdu soo gasho daah ama blind ku xidh, habeenkii marka heerkulka dibaddu ka hooseeyo gudaha daaqadda fur oo hawo geli, kadibna air conditioner-ka ku dhig 26~27°C.

p-229.title: 1~2 saacadood intaadan seexan, qubays diiran
p-229.summary: Qubays diiran 1~2 saacadood intaadan seexan wuxuu kuleylka jidhka dibadda uga dhiibaa oo wuxuu sameeyaa isbeddel heerkul oo fududeeya hurdada.
p-229.principle: Marka biyaha diiran ay ballaariyaan xididdada dhinacyada, kuleylku wuxuu ka baxaa maqaarka oo heerkulka dhexe ee jidhku wuu hoos u dhacaa: $q = hA(T_s - T_a)$.
p-229.example: Haddii 10 daqiiqo laga qubaysto biyo ku dhawaad 40°C ah oo 1~2 saacadood kadib la seexdo, cilmi-baaris ayaa lagu soo warramay in waqtiga hurdada celcelis ahaan ku dhawaad 10 daqiiqo ay gaabatay.
p-229.actionItem: Maanta 1~2 saacadood intaadan seexan, 10 daqiiqo ku qubays biyo ku dhawaad 40°C ah.

p-230.title: Plunger-ka (xaaqiyaha) waxaa la furayaa marka la jiido, ma aha marka la riixo
p-230.summary: Plunger-ku waa qalab koobka biyaha ku dhegsada, ka dibna xoog u jiida si uu u dhaqaajiyo qaybta xirtay oo u soo saaro.
p-230.principle: Farqiga cadaadiska gudaha iyo dibadda koobku wuxuu abuuraa xoog: $F = \Delta P \cdot A$. Biyo ayaa lagu buuxiyaa ma aha hawo si cadaadisku u gudbo.
p-230.example: Koob aag $0.01\ \mathrm{m^2}$ $\Delta P = 5\ \mathrm{kPa}$ marka ay tahay, meesha xirtay waxaa ku dhaca xoog ku dhawaad 50N (ku dhawaad 5 kgf).
p-230.actionItem: Maanta koobka godka dhaadhaca biyaha ku quus, ka dibna ku dheji, si fudud riix oo kadibna xoog u jiid 10 jeer (kaligiis isticmaal, kimiko la'aan).

p-231.title: Isbaarrooyin cufan oo godad badan leh xoog yar ayuu ku dhacaa
p-231.summary: Marka masaafada u dhexeysa threads (pitch) ay yar tahay, isla xoog si xoog badan ayaa loo xidhi karaa, sidaas darteed qori adag, isbaarro khafiif ah ayaa faa'iido leh.
p-231.principle: Faa'iidada farsamo ee ideal ee isbaarku waa $MA = \dfrac{2\pi r}{p}$ ($r$: radius-ka screwdriver, $p$: pitch).
p-231.example: Marka $r = 2\ \mathrm{mm}$, pitch 1.0mm waa $MA \approx 12.6$, 0.5mm waa $MA \approx 25$ oo xoog badh ayaa loo baahan yahay (friction la dayo).
p-231.actionItem: Maanta qori adag u dooro isbaarro pitch cufan oo hore godka hore u qodo.

p-232.title: Jimicsiga rubber band-ka, iska caabbinta way ku kala duwan tahay dherer
p-232.summary: Elastic band-ku iska caabbintiisa waxay ku dhawaad u dhigantaa dhererka la fidiyay, sidaas darteed isla dherer la fidiyo waa halbeegga xoogga jimicsiga.
p-232.principle: Sharciga Hooke: $F = kx$ (rubber band-ka marka si weyn loo fidiyo ma aha linear, sidaas darteed waa qiyaas).
p-232.example: Band $k = 100\ \mathrm{N/m}$ marka 0.3m la fidiyo wuxuu bixiyaa iska caabbin ku dhawaad 30N, marka 0.6m la fidiyo ku dhawaad 60N.
p-232.actionItem: Maanta marka aad band jimicsi sameynayso, gacmaha masaafada u calaamadee oo mar kasta isla dherer fidi.

p-233.title: Dabayl qabow oo ka hor timaada roobka, waa calaamad nabadgelyo raadis
p-233.summary: Dabayl qabow oo lama filaan ah oo ka hor timaada duufaanka waa hoos u socodka hawada qabow ee onkodka, oo calaamad u ah in dhawaan onkod iyo duufaan yimaado.
p-233.principle: Hawada qabow cufnaanteeda way weyn tahay hoos ayay u degtaa oo way faafaa: $\rho = \dfrac{P}{R_s T}$.
p-233.example: 1 atmosphere, cufnaanta hawada 30°C waa ku dhawaad $1.165\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$, 20°C ku dhawaad $1.204\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$, ku dhawaad 3% ayay ka culus tahay, duufaantu waxay ka dabayli kartaa 60~90km saacaddii.
p-233.actionItem: Maanta haddii aad dibadda joogto oo lama filaan dabayl qabow ay timaado oo aad onkod maqasho, isla markiiba gal dhismaha ama gaarigaaga.

p-234.title: Air conditioner-ka gaariga, marka hore hawada dibadda, marka qaboobo hawo wareegga gudaha
p-234.summary: Marka aad soo gashid kadib daaqadaha fur si hawada kulul looga saaro, marka gudaha qaboobo beddel recirculation-ka gudaha si culeyska qabowga loo yareeyo.
p-234.principle: Culeyska qabowgu wuxuu u dhigmaa qulqulka hawada iyo farqiga heerkulka: $\dot{Q} = \dot{m}\, c_p\, \Delta T$.
p-234.example: $\dot{m} = 0.1\ \mathrm{kg/s}$, $c_p = 1.005\ \mathrm{kJ/(kg\cdot K)}$ marka hawada dibadda 35°C→22°C ku dhawaad 1.3kW, hawada gudaha 25°C→22°C ku dhawaad 0.3kW.
p-234.actionItem: Maanta marka aad gaariga gasho, daaqadda 1 daqiiqo fur si hawo geliso, marka ay qaboowdo recirculation-ka gudaha beddel (safarka dheer marmar hawada dibadda geli).

p-235.title: Sawirrada habeenka ee ruxan, sharciga shutter 1/focal length
p-235.summary: Marka gacanta lagu sawirayo, haddii waqtiga shutter-ku ka gaabnaado dhererka diirada lens-ka, ruxitaanka gacanta way yaraan kartaa si weyn.
p-235.principle: Sharciga khibradda: $t \le \dfrac{1}{f}$ (marka dhererka diirada full-frame $f$ mm yahay $t$ ilbiriqsi).
p-235.example: Lens 50mm waa ku dhawaad 1/50 ilbiriqsi, lens 200mm waa ku dhawaad 1/200 ilbiriqsi ama ka yar waa badbaado, haddii mugdi yahay ISO kor u qaad ama jidhka xasili.
p-235.actionItem: Maanta marka aad sawirka habeenka qaadanayso, suxulka jidhka ku dhaji ama derbiga ku tiirso oo 2 ilbiriqsi timer ku qaado.

p-236.title: Dabka xeradu wuu sii gubtaa marka qoryaha la taagay
p-236.summary: Haddii qoryaha dabka si taagan oo qalloocan loo isku tiirsado, chimney effect-ka awgeed hawada hoosta ayaa laga nuugaa dabkuna si fiican ayuu u shidmaa.
p-236.principle: Cadaadiska draft-ka ee tiirka gaaska kulul sameeyo: $\Delta P \approx \rho g h \dfrac{\Delta T}{T}$.
p-236.example: Dherer $h = 0.5\ \mathrm{m}$, dhinaca dabka 600K, hawada dibadda 300K $\Delta P \approx 1.2 \times 9.8 \times 0.5 \times \dfrac{300}{600} \approx 3\ \mathrm{Pa}$.
p-236.actionItem: Maanta kaambada marka aad qoryaha dabka u taagto sida teendho yar, biyo agtaada dhig, meelaha dab-ka-reebanka ha shidin.

p-237.title: Xataa haddii baraf dhalaalo, biyaha koobku ma daadanayaan
p-237.summary: Barafka biyaha dul sabaynayaa marka uu dhalaalo heerka biyuhu ku dhawaad isma beddelo, sidaas darteed xitaa koob buuxa ma daadanayo.
p-237.principle: Barafka sabeynayaa wuxuu durkaa biyo u dhigma culeyskiisa: $V_{\mathrm{d}} = \dfrac{m}{\rho_w}$, mugga biyaha dhalaalay-na $\dfrac{m}{\rho_w}$.
p-237.example: 90g baraf wuxuu durkaa 90mL biyo (mugga guud ku dhawaad $98\ \mathrm{cm^3}$ ka mid ah ku dhawaad $8\ \mathrm{cm^3}$ oo keliya kor ayaa u soo baxa), marka uu dhalaalo wuxuu noqdaa 90mL oo heerka biyuhu isku mid yahay.
p-237.actionItem: Maanta koob baraf iyo biyo buuxi oo daawo heerka biyaha ilaa uu dhalaalo (gacanta ha ku riixin).

p-238.title: Pressure gauge-ka dab-demiyaha, aagga cagaaran hubi
p-238.summary: Dab-demiyaha cadaadiska leh waa inuu gauge-ka fiiqanku ku jiro aagga cagaaran (caadi 0.7~0.98MPa) si loo isticmaalo.
p-238.principle: Cadaadisku waa xoog halkii cabbir aag: $P = \dfrac{F}{A}$. Haddii gaasku ka baxo cadaadiska weelka ayaa hoos u dhaca oo xoogga buufintu wuu yaraadaa.
p-238.example: Xadka caadiga ah 0.7~0.98MPa waa ku dhawaad 7~9.8bar (7~10 jibaar cadaadiska jawiga), haddii fiiqanku yahay aagga casaanka ama 0 u dhow, beddelid ama dib u buuxin ayaa loo baahan yahay.
p-238.actionItem: Maanta hubi in gauge-ka dab-demiyaha guriga ama gaariga uu ku jiro aagga cagaaran, oo sidoo kale hubi pin-ka badbaadada iyo xaaladda tuubada.

p-239.title: Seesaw-ga, qofka culus marka uu xarunta u dhow fadhiisto wuu isu simmaa
p-239.summary: Xitaa labo qof oo culeys kala duwan leh, haddii qofka culus uu xarunta u dhow fadhiisto seesaw-gu wuu isu simmaa.
p-239.example: Ilmo 30kg ah oo xarunta ka fog 2m iyo ilmo 60kg ah oo 1m ka fog fadhiistaan $30 \times 2 = 60 \times 1$ ayaa dheelitirmaya.
p-239.actionItem: Maanta marka aad ilmaha la tagto goobta ciyaarta, beddel meesha laba qof fadhiistaan oo raadi barta dheelitirka, kadibna mid mid ammaan ugu degdeg.

p-240.title: Maxay sababta jiraan farqi isku xirka buundooyinka iyo wadooyinka xagaaga
p-240.summary: Bir iyo concrete way fidmaan marka ay kululaadaan, sidaas darteed buundooyinka iyo wadooyinka waxaa lagu daryaa farqiyo isku xirka ah si ay meel u yeeshaan fidinta.
p-240.example: Qayb 100m ah oo bir ($\alpha \approx 12 \times 10^{-6}\ \mathrm{/K}$) ah marka -10°C laga beddelo 40°C $\Delta L \approx 0.06\ \mathrm{m}$, taas oo ah ku dhawaad 60mm kordh.
p-240.actionItem: Maanta marka aad maraysid buundo ama dhidibka dhabarka, raadi farqiyada oo dhagax ama qashin ha ku dhex gelin.

p-241.title: Batteriyada toosha, series waa iftiin badan, parallel waa waqti dheer
p-241.summary: Haddii batteriyada series loo xiro danabku wuu kordhaa oo iftiin badan, haddii parallel loo xiro danabku isku mid yahay awooduna waa isku dhacdaa oo waqti dheer ayay ahaadaan, laakiin tamarta guud waa isku mid.
p-241.principle: Series: $V = V_1 + V_2$, parallel: $Q = Q_1 + Q_2$. Tamar $E = VQ$.
p-241.example: Laba battery oo 1.5V·2500 mAh ah series 3V·2.5 Ah, parallel 1.5V·5 Ah, labadaba waa ku dhawaad 7.5Wh.
p-241.actionItem: Maanta batteriyada toosha isla nooc iyo isla haraa isku mar beddel, oo kuwa cusub iyo kuwa duugga ah ha isku dhex darin.

p-242.title: Muuqaal xeebta, daboolka dabayl-celinta si loo yareeyo codka dabayshu
p-242.summary: Daboolka dabayl-celinta dhogorta ah ee hor yimaada microphone-ka wuxuu kala firdhiyaa turbulence oo wuxuu si weyn u yareeyaa buuq dabayl.
p-242.principle: Halbeegga socodka ay noqoto turbulent waa lambarka Reynolds: $\mathrm{Re} = \dfrac{\rho v D}{\mu}$.
p-242.example: Xawaaraha dabayshu 5m/s, dhexroorka microphone-ka 1cm $\mathrm{Re} \approx 3{,}300$ oo daboolka dhogorta ahi wuxuu yareeyaa buuq dabayl ku dhawaad 10~20dB.
p-242.actionItem: Maanta marka xeebta lagu duubayo muuqaal, daboolka dhogorta ah saar oo microphone-ka u jeedi dhinaca ka soo horjeedda dabayshu.

p-243.title: Maxay sababta touchscreen-ku ugu shaqeyn waayo gacmaha qoyan
p-243.summary: Dhibcaha biyuhu waxay gudbiyaan koronto oo shaashadda way ku faafaan, waxayna beddelaan capacitance-ka electrodes badan sidaas darteed ghost touch ayaa dhaca.
p-243.principle: Capacitance: $C = \dfrac{\varepsilon A}{d}$ (relative permittivity-ga biyuhu ku dhawaad 80, hawada ku dhawaad 1).
p-243.example: Marka dhibcaha biyuhu taabtaan, sensor-ku wuxuu akhriyi karaa isbeddel capacitance oo la mid ah farta, sidaas darteed xitaa haddii shaashaddu aysan jabnayn, qalad-shaqeyn ayaa badanaa dhacda.
p-243.actionItem: Maanta haddii shaashaddu cajiib tahay, intaadan dayactirin gacmaha iyo shaashadda biyaha ku nadiifi maro qalalan.

p-244.title: Burner-ka kaambada, dabayl-celiyaha ku wareeji laakiin weelka gaaska ha ku duubin
p-244.summary: Dabayl-celintu waxay yaraysaa kuleylka lumay ee burner-ka iyo dheriga, laakiin haddii weelka gaaska la duubo way kululaan oo khatar ayay tahay.
p-244.principle: Convective heat loss: $q = hA\Delta T$ (marka dabayshu xoog badan tahay $h$ wuu weynaadaa).
p-244.example: Dusha dheriga $0.05\ \mathrm{m^2}$, $\Delta T = 80\ \mathrm{K}$ marka $h$ 10 ilaa 30 $\mathrm{W/(m^2\cdot K)}$ kordho lumitaanku wuxuu ka kordhaa 40W ilaa 120W (tusaale).
p-244.actionItem: Maanta marka dibadda laga kariyo, dabayl-celiyaha agagaarka dheriga iyo burner-ka oo keliya dhig, weelka gaaska dibadda ku dhaaf (gudaha ama teendho dhexdeeda ha isticmaalin).

p-245.title: Sababta ceeryaamo uga samaysanto aroor dayrta ah oo cadceed leh
p-245.summary: Habeenada cad ee dabayl la'aanta ah, dhulku wuu qaboobaa iyadoo shucaac lumiyo, hawaduna marka ay gaarto dhibcaha shambada waxaa dhasha ceeryaamo.
p-245.principle: Qiyaasta dhibcaha shambada: $T_d \approx T - \dfrac{100 - \mathrm{RH}}{5}$ (°C, RH waa %).
p-245.example: Haddii maalintii ay 20°C tahay qoyaanku 70%, markaas $T_d \approx 14$°C, haddii aroorta ay ku dhacdo 12°C, hawadu way dhergaysaa oo ceeryaamo ayaa samaysanta.
p-245.actionItem: Maanta haddii aad aroor ceeryaamo leh wadid, shid iftiinka hoose iyo iftiinka ceeryaamada, kana dhig masaafada gaadhiga ka horreeya mid ka weyn sidii caadiga ah.

p-246.title: Gears-ka baaskiilka ku hagaaji cadence, ee ha ku hagaajin xoog
p-246.summary: Haddii awoodu isku mid tahay, gear u oggolaanaya inaad cagaha ku wareejiso 70~90 jeer daqiiqadii si khafiif ah ayaa yareeya culeyska jilibka.
p-246.principle: Awoodu waa wax-isku-dhufashada torque iyo xawaaraha geesoodka ah: $P = \tau \omega$, $\omega = \dfrac{2\pi \cdot \mathrm{rpm}}{60}$.
p-246.example: Marka la soo saarayo awood ku dhow 210W, 60 rpm waxay u baahan tahay torque ku dhow 33N·m, 90 rpm-na ku dhow 22N·m.
p-246.actionItem: Maanta markaad baaskiil gaadhayso, beddel gear-ka oo ku haay wareegga cagaha 70~90 jeer daqiiqadii.

p-247.title: Dhul-dheerta qoyan (gobolka laaska) maalin kasta wuxuu furmaa ku dhawaad 50 daqiiqo hadhow
p-247.summary: Dayaxu wuxuu u baahan yahay ku dhawaad 50 daqiiqo oo dheeraad ah si uu dhulka ugu wareego hal mar maalintii, sidaas darteed wakhtiga biyuhu kor u kaco iyo hoos u dhacaba maalin kasta wuxuu dib u dhacaa ku dhawaad 50 daqiiqo.
p-247.principle: Maalinta dayaxu waa $T_{\mathrm{lunar}} \approx 24\ \mathrm{h}\ 50\ \mathrm{min}$, kor-u-kaca iyo hoos-u-dhaca biyuhuna waxay dhacaan laba jeer maalintii, sidaas darteed farqiga u dhexeeya waa ku dhawaad 12 saacadood iyo 25 daqiiqo.
p-247.example: Haddii maanta hoos-u-dhacu yahay 10:00, berri wuxuu noqonayaa ku dhawaad 10:50, lix maalmood ka dib waa $6 \times 50 = 300$ daqiiqo dib u dhac, ku dhawaad 15:00.
p-247.actionItem: Maanta kahor intaanad tagin dhul-dheerta qoyan, hubi jadwalka biyaha, oo go'aami wakhtiga aad ka bixi doonto kahor intaan biyuhu soo gelin.

p-248.title: Mashiinka vacuum-ka baakadaynta waa xoogga cadaadiska hawada dibadda ee riixaya
p-248.summary: Mashiinka vacuum-ka baakadaynta wuxuu ka saaraa hawada gudaha bacda, cadaadiska hawada dibadduna wuxuu cuntada riixaa oo ku dhejiyaa.
p-248.example: Haddii baaxadda bacdu tahay $0.03\ \mathrm{m^2}$ oo farqiga cadaadisku yahay 80kPa, xoog ku dhow 2.4kN (ku dhawaad 240 kgf) ayaa si loo qaybiyey ugu dhaca dhammaan.
p-248.actionItem: Maanta baako cunto qalalan ama qaybo yaryar oo la qaboojinayo, laakiin cuntada si dhakhso ah u xumaata weli ku keydi qaboojiyaha ama qaboojiyaha baraf.

p-249.title: Awoodda uumiga ayaa cuntada si dhakhso ah u kariya iyadoo la adeegsanayo kulaylka isku-ururka uumiga
p-249.summary: Uumigu wuxuu dusha cuntada ku isku-urursadaa biyo, isagoo sii daynaya kulayl badan oo qarsoon, sidaas darteed wuxuu kulaylka u gudbiyaa si ka dhakhso badan biyaha karkaraya.
p-249.principle: Kulaylka la sii daayo markii uu isku-urursado: $Q = mL$ ($L \approx 2260\ \mathrm{kJ/kg}$).
p-249.example: Marka 50g oo uumi ah ay isku-urursadaan, waxay sii daayaan ku dhawaad 113kJ, taas oo ka badan ku dhawaad 6.8 jeer marka 50g oo biyo ah oo 100°C ah ay u qaboobaan 20°C (ku dhawaad 16.7kJ).
p-249.actionItem: Maanta markaad uumiga kariso, daboolka xidhan ku hay, markaad furayso daboolka kor u qaad si uu uga durugsan yahay wejigaaga si aad uga hortagto gubashada uumiga.

p-250.title: Codka jiriidka ayaa lagu qiyaasi karaa heerkulka
p-250.summary: Jiriidku marka uu kulushahay si dhakhso ah ayuu u heesaa, sidaas darteed tirada hees-yadiisa waxaa lagu qiyaasi karaa heerkulka hawada.
p-250.principle: Sharciga Dolbear: $T_{\mathrm{F}} \approx 40 + \dfrac{N_{60}}{4}$ ($N_{60}$: tirada heesaha hal daqiiqo gudaheed).
p-250.example: Haddii hal daqiiqo ay 100 jeer ku heesto, waa ku dhawaad 65°F (ku dhawaad 18°C), 160 jeer-na waa ku dhawaad 80°F (ku dhawaad 27°C); waa qiyaas leh khalad kala duwan noocyada awgood.
p-250.actionItem: Maanta fiidkii tiri codka jiriidka 15 ilbiriqsi, ku dhufo 4, kadibna isticmaal qaacidada sare si aad u qiyaasto heerkulka.

p-251.title: Sababta qorrax-dhaca/qorrax-ka-soo-baxa ay u gubanayso
p-251.summary: Marka qorraxdu hoos u dhacdo, iftiinku wuxuu hawada dheer ka dhex maraa, iftiinka buluuga ahna horta ayuu kala firidhaa, iftiinka casaanna wuu hadhaa, sidaas darteed cirku wuu casaadaa.
p-251.example: Buluug (450nm) wuxuu ka xoog badan yahay casaan (700nm) $(700/450)^4 \approx 5.9$ jeer marka la kala firdhinayo, sidaas darteed horta ayuu u dhammaadaa.
p-251.actionItem: Maanta fiiri isbeddelka midabka cirka markii qorraxdu dhacayso, laakiin ha eegin qorraxda si toos ah, hana ku toosin qorraxda kamarad ama teleskoob.

p-252.title: Dayaxa buuxa wuxuu u muuqdaa mid u eg qadaadiic lacag oo fog la dhigay
p-252.summary: Dayaxa buuxa wuu ka yar yahay sida la filayo; marka gacanta la dheereeyo, hal xabbo bariis ayaa daboolaysa.
p-252.example: Qadaadiic lacag ah oo dhexroorkiisu yahay 24mm haddii la dhigo ku dhawaad 2.7m ka fog, wuxuu leeyahay isla cabbirka geesoodka ah, marka gacanta dhererkeedu yahay ku dhawaad 60cm, shay dhexroorkiisu yahay ku dhawaad 5mm ayaa dayaxa daboola.
p-252.actionItem: Maanta markii dayaxa buuxa soo baxo, gacanta si buuxda u dheereey oo hal xabbo bariis ku dabool dayaxa.

p-253.title: Isku-buuqa wadada markii loo socdaalayo aroosyada waxaa bilaabma hal jeer oo gaadhiga hore jebiyo
p-253.summary: Wadada cufnaanteedu sarreyso, marka hal gaadhi jebiyo, dib-u-dhaca falcelinta gaadhiyada ka dambeeya ayaa isu uruura, mowjadda isku-buuqu na dib ayey u faaftaa.
p-253.principle: Masaafada joojinta: $d = v\,t_r + \dfrac{v^2}{2a}$, mowjadda isku-buuqu badanaa waxay dib ugu faaftaa ku dhawaad 15~20km saacaddii.
p-253.example: Marka xawaaruhu yahay 100km saacaddii (ku dhawaad 27.8m/s), hal ilbiriqsi oo falcelin ah waxay keenaysaa in gaadhigu 27.8m ku maro isagoo aan wax samayn, haddii la ilaaliyo kala fogaansho 3 ilbiriqsi ah oo si jilicsan loo wado, shidaalka waa lagu badbaadin karaa ku dhawaad 5~10%.
p-253.actionItem: Maanta markaad wadayso, u dhaaf gaadhiga hore 2~3 ilbiriqsi, oo dhakhso uga qaad cagta gaaska si aad u yarayso isticmaalka jebiyaha.

p-254.title: Masaafada badbaadada ee dhagxaanta ka firidhka mashiinka cawska jarka waa 15m ama ka badan
p-254.summary: Cidhifka toosinka mashiinka cawska jarka aad buu u dhakhso badan yahay, sidaas darteed dhagxaanta waxay u firdhaan sida rasaas, markaa gudaha 15m ee goobta shaqada ma jirin waa in cid jirin.
p-254.principle: Xawaaraha cidhifka toosinka: $v = \omega r$, masaafada firidhka: $R = \dfrac{v^2 \sin 2\theta}{g}$.
p-254.example: Haddii radius-ka toosinku yahay 0.115m, 6,500 rpm ($\omega \approx 681\ \mathrm{rad/s}$), markaas $v \approx 78\ \mathrm{m/s}$, taas oo ah ku dhawaad 280km saacaddii.
p-254.actionItem: Maanta kahor intaadan cawska jarin, hubi in gudaha 15m aysan jirin dad ama gaadhi, oo xidh muraayadaha badbaadada iyo daboolka wajiga.

p-255.title: Bacaha hurdada u fiiri heerkulka raaxada, mataracana u fiiri qiimaha R
p-255.summary: Qabowga habeenka, kulaylka dhulka u dhaca wuu ka badan yahay kan kor u dhaca, sidaas darteed waxaa la eegaa heerkulka raaxada ee bacda hurdada iyo qiimaha R ee mataracka si wada jir ah.
p-255.example: Mataraca xumbada ah ee dhumucdiisu 2cm, $k = 0.035\ \mathrm{W/(m\cdot K)}$ wuxuu leeyahay $R \approx 0.57\ \mathrm{m^2K/W}$ (qiimaha R ee Maraykanka ku dhawaad 3.2), kaymis dayrta, R oo 3 ama ka badan waa halbeeg caadi ah.
p-255.actionItem: Maanta markaad doorbidayso qalabka kaymiska, hubi in heerkulka raaxada ee bacda hurdada uu yahay heerkulka ugu hooseeya ee la filayo ama ka hooseeyo, iyo in qiimaha R ee mataracku yahay 3 ama ka badan.

p-256.title: Dareemaha cadaadiska hawada ee taleefanka ayaa lagu akhriyi karaa isbeddelka dhererka
p-256.summary: Taleefannada badankood waxay leeyihiin dareeme cadaadiska hawada, sidaas darteed isbeddelka cadaadiska ayaa lagu qiyaasi karaa dhererka la fuulay ama la dhaadhacay.
p-256.principle: $\Delta P \approx -\rho g\,\Delta h$, agagaarka heerka badda hoos u dhac ku dhow 1hPa = kor u kac ku dhow 8m.
p-256.example: Haddii $\rho = 1.2\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$, 8m kasta waxay noqonaysaa $1.2 \times 9.8 \times 8 \approx 94\ \mathrm{Pa} \approx 0.94\ \mathrm{hPa}$, sidaas darteed dhismaha 30 dabaq (ku dhawaad 90m) wuxuu hoos u dhacaa ku dhawaad 11hPa.
p-256.actionItem: Maanta fur app-ka barometer-ka oo is barbar dhig qiimaha dabaqa hoose iyo dabaqa kore ee jaranjarada (cimiladu sidoo kale way beddelaysaa qiimaha, sidaas darteed ku cabbir waqti gaaban).

p-257.title: Shelf-yada buugaagta iyo qaboojiyaha ku xidh derbiga si aad uga hortagto dhulgariirka
p-257.summary: Alaabta dheer oo cidhiidhiga ah waxay ku dhacdaa xitaa gariir yar, sidaas darteed haddii la ku xidho derbiga waa badbaado.
p-257.principle: Shuruudda dhicitaanka: $mg\,\dfrac{b}{2} < m a\, h_c$, taas oo ah $a > g\,\dfrac{b}{2 h_c}$ ($b$: baaxadda, $h_c$: dhererka xarunta cuf-wadaaga).
p-257.example: Shelf dhererkiisu yahay 1.8m ($h_c = 0.9\ \mathrm{m}$), baaxaddiisuna 0.3m wuxuu ku dhacaa marka $a > 0.3/1.8\, g \approx 0.17\,g$.
p-257.actionItem: Maanta ku xidh alaabta dheer tiirka derbiga adigoo isticmaalaya L-bracket, alaabta culus-na dhig meelaha hoose.

p-258.title: Sababta codka gitaarku isu beddelo marka xilliga isbeddelku leeyahay kala duwanaansho heerkul weyn
p-258.summary: Marka heerkulku isbeddelo, xiisaha xadhigu wuu is beddelaa, codkuna wuu is beddelaa, sidaas darteed kahor intaad ciyaarin waa in mar kale la hagaajiyo.
p-258.example: Haddii xiisku 1% yaraado, soo noqnoqoshadu waxay hoos u dhacdaa ku dhawaad 0.5%, codka 440Hz wuxuu hoos u dhacaa ku dhawaad 2.2Hz (ku dhawaad 9 cent), kaas oo dhegta ka xanaajin kara.
p-258.actionItem: Maanta kahor intaadan ciyaarin, mar kale ku hagaaji xadhigyada tuner (iyo mar kale marka isbeddelku deggan yahay ka dib ciyaarta).

p-259.title: Marka laga gudbayo kooxda qalooca ah ee garoonka, jidhka u janjeedh gudaha
p-259.summary: Marka qalooc laga leexanayo, haddii jidhka gudaha loo janjeediyo, xoogga xoqiddu wuxuu abuuraa xoogga dhex-u-jeeda, sidaas darteed adigoo aan simbirin ayaad leexanaysaa.
p-259.example: Haddii qalooc radius-kiisu yahay 20m laga leexdo xawaare 14.4km saacaddii (4m/s), $\tan\theta \approx 16/196 \approx 0.082$, taas oo ah janjeer ku dhow 4.7°.
p-259.actionItem: Maanta qaybaha qalooca ah, hore u yaree xawaaraha, kadibna garabka cagta ka bilow oo si yar u janjeedh gudaha si aad u leexato.

p-260.title: Haddii dhaadheerka diyaaradda uu muddo dheer hadho, cirku waa qoyan yahay
p-260.summary: Haddii dhaadheerka diyaaradda aanu si dhakhso ah u lumin ee uu faafo, waxay tilmaamaysaa in cirka sare uu qoyaan ku filan yahay si uu ugu ka-buuxsamo barafka.
p-260.principle: Qoyaanka cutubka barafka: $\mathrm{RH}_i = \dfrac{e}{e_i} \times 100\%$, haddii $\mathrm{RH}_i > 100\%$ dhaadheerka diyaaraddu wuu sii jiraa.
p-260.example: Ku dhawaad -40°C, cadaadiska uumiga buuxinta ee barafku waa ku dhawaad 68% kan biyaha, sidaas darteed xitaa qoyaanka biyaha oo 70% ah wuxuu keenaa $\mathrm{RH}_i > 100\%$.
p-260.actionItem: Maanta fiiri inta dhaadheerka diyaaradaha cirka uu hadho, oo haddii uu dheeraado oo faafo u qaado calaamad tixraac ah oo laga yaabo in lakabka sare qoyan yahay (ma aha saadaal).

p-261.title: Haddii chopsticks lagu dhejiyo weelka bariiska, weelka ayaa la qaadi karaa
p-261.summary: Haddii bariiska la cufo oo chopsticks la geliyo, miraha bariisku si adag ayay chopsticks u qabtaan, sidaas darteed weelka oo dhan ayaa kor loo qaadi karaa.
p-261.principle: Cadaadiska u dhexeeya miraha bariiska ayaa chopsticks-ka cabbiya, abuurayana xoqid: $f = \mu N$.
p-261.example: Tusaale ahaan, haddii xoogga dhinaca ka riixa $N = 50\ \mathrm{N}$, $\mu = 0.4$, xoqiddu waa ku dhawaad 20N, taas oo qaadi karta weel bariis ah oo ku dhow 1kg (ku dhawaad 9.8N).
p-261.actionItem: Maanta weel muraayad ah oo cidhiidhi ah ku buuxi bariis, cufo, kadibna chopsticks si qoto dheer u gali oo kor u qaad (miiska korkiisa ka samee si weelku u jabin).

p-262.title: Midhaha, haddii cabbirkoodu isku mid yahay, dooro kan ka culus
p-262.summary: Haddii cabbirku isku mid yahay, midhaha ka culus badanaa waxay leeyihiin biyo badan oo aan ka engegnayn.
p-262.example: Haddii laba liin oo mugga isku mid ah ay yihiin 220g ($\rho \approx 1.10\ \mathrm{g/cm^3}$) iyo 190g ($\rho \approx 0.95\ \mathrm{g/cm^3}$), midda ka culus badanaa waxay leedahay cabitaan badan.
p-262.actionItem: Maanta markaad midho iibsanayso, labada gacmood ku qaad kuwa cabbirkoodu isku mid yahay oo is barbar dhig culeyskooda, oo hubi inaysan nabaro lahayn.

p-263.title: Marka lagu socdo wadada dhaqaajisa ee garoonka diyaaradaha, xawaarooyinka ayaa is raaca
p-263.summary: Marka lagu socdo korka wadada dhaqaajisa, xawaaraha socodka waxaa lagu daraa xawaaraha wadada, sidaas darteed aad ayaad u dhakhso badan tahay.
p-263.example: Haddii wadada dhaqaajisa 0.75m/s lagu daro socodka 1.4m/s, waa 2.15m/s, 200m markaad taagan tahay waa ku dhawaad 267 ilbiriqsi, marka la socdo waa ku dhawaad 93 ilbiriqsi, taas oo ah ku dhawaad 3 daqiiqo oo ka dhakhso badan.
p-263.actionItem: Maanta marka aad ku socoto wadada dhaqaajisa, dhinac ku dhaji, gacan ku qabo, alaabtana jidhkaaga u dhow ku hay.

p-264.title: Dhejiska milicsiga baaskiilka ayaa iftiinka dib ugu celiya
p-264.summary: Dhejiska milicsiga dib-u-celinta wuxuu iftiinka gaadhiga dib ugu celiyaa jihada uu ka yimid, sidaas darteed baaskiilka ayuu ka dhigaa mid muuqda wadada mugdiga ah.
p-264.principle: Corner cube wuxuu iftiinka dib ugu celiyaa jihada ka soo horjeedda isagoo adeegsanaya saddex muraayadood oo isku taaban: $\vec{r}_{out} = -\vec{r}_{in}$.
p-264.example: Qalabka milicsiga badanaa waa la arki karaa xitaa ku dhawaad 150m ka fog, halka dharka madow badanaa lagu arko gudaha 30~50m oo keliya.
p-264.actionItem: Maanta baaskiilka giraangiraha, qaabka iyo cagaha ku dhaji dhejiska milicsiga, oo wadajir u shid nalka hore iyo kan dambe.

p-265.title: Maaddada kulul ee shorbada ha si toos ah ugu dhex gelin blender-ka
p-265.summary: Haddii shorbo kulul lagu shubo blender xidhan oo la shido, uumigu wuu balaadhaa oo daboolka ayuu soo boodaa, waxaana laga yaabaa inuu gubo.
p-265.principle: Gaaska ugu habboon: $PV = nRT$. Marka 1g oo biyo ah ay noqoto uumi 100°C iyo 1atm, mugga wuxuu noqdaa ku dhawaad 1.7L.
p-265.example: Haddii $n = \dfrac{1}{18} \approx 0.056\ \mathrm{mol}$, $V = \dfrac{nRT}{P} \approx 1.7\ \mathrm{L}$, waxay balaadhataa ku dhawaad 1,700 jeer mugga dareeraha.
p-265.actionItem: Maanta shorbada kulul ka dhig mid qabow ugu yaraan 10 daqiiqo, ku buuxi kala bar ama ka yar awoodda, daboolka daloolkiisa fur oo tuwaal ku dabool kadibna shid.

p-266.title: Sababta equinox-ka dayrta maalinta iyo habeenku ay ku dhow yihiin isku mid
p-266.summary: Equinox-ka dayrta, qorraxdu waxay toos ka dul taagan tahay dhulbaraha, sidaas darteed meel kasta oo dunida ah, maalinta iyo habeenku way ku dhow yihiin 12 saacadood mid kasta.
p-266.example: Deklination-ku waa +23.4° solstice-ka kulaylaha (ku dhawaad 21-ka Juun), 0° equinox-ka dayrta (ku dhawaad 22-ka Sebtembar), -23.4° solstice-ka jiilaalka (ku dhawaad 21-ka Diseembar).
p-266.actionItem: Maanta hubi wakhtiga qorrax-soo-baxa iyo qorrax-dhaca oo xisaabi in dhererka maalintu yahay ku dhawaad 12 saacadood.

p-267.title: Hawo ka saarida boilerka iyo radiator-ka xilliga isbeddelka
p-267.summary: Marka dhuumaha kulayliyuhu hawo buuxdo, biyuhu si wanaagsan uma wareegaan, sidaas darteed qaybta sare ee radiator-ku way qabow tahay. Haddii hawada la saaro, isla shidaal ayaa kuu kululeeya.
p-267.principle: Kulaylka la bixiyo wuxuu u dhigmaa qulqulka wareegga: $Q = \dot{m}\, c\, \Delta T$.
p-267.example: Radiator 1kW ah marka $\Delta T = 15\ \mathrm{K}$ waxay u baahan tahay in biyuhu qulqulaan ku dhawaad $1\ \mathrm{L/min}$, qaybta hawo buuxdana kulayl ma bixiso.
p-267.actionItem: Dami kululeynta oo sug inta ay qaboojiso, kadibna fur valve-ka hawada ee radiator-ka qaybtiisa sare qabow si hawada loo saaro, oo hubi cadaadiska boilerka sida buugga tilmaamaha ku xusan.

p-268.title: Marka dhul janjeera la dhigto gaadhiga, giraangiraha u jeedi oo xaafadda u dhig
p-268.summary: Marka dhul janjeera lagu dhigo gaadhiga, marka laga sokow isticmaalo brake-ga gacanta iyo gear-ka, giraangiraha u jeedi dhinaca xaafadda si haddii uu simbiriirixdo, xaafaddu ay joojiso.
p-268.principle: Xoogga jihada janjeerka: $F = mg\sin\theta$, xoqid: $f = \mu N$.
p-268.example: Gaadhi 1,500kg ah marka uu taagan yahay dhul janjeer 10% ah ($\theta \approx 5.7^\circ$), waxaa hoos u jiidaya ku dhawaad 1.46kN (ku dhawaad 150 kgf).
p-268.actionItem: Maanta marka hoos-u-dhaca la dhigto, giraangiraha u jeedi xaafadda; marka kor-u-kaca xaafad lagu dhigto, dhinaca kale u jeedi, oo qabo brake-ga gacanta iyo P (ama gear 1).

p-269.title: Muuqaalka dhow ee daaqadda tareenka ayaa si dhakhso badan u dhaafa
p-269.summary: Xitaa haddii xawaaruhu isku mid yahay, shayada dhow aragtidu aad bay u dhakhso badan wareegtaa, sidaas darteed si dhakhso ah ayay u dhaafaan, buuraha fogna si tartiib ah ayay u muuqdaan.
p-269.example: Xawaare 100km saacaddii (27.8m/s), geed 20m ka fog waa $\omega \approx 1.39\ \mathrm{rad/s} \approx 80^\circ/\mathrm{s}$, buurta 5km ka fog waa ku dhawaad $0.3^\circ/\mathrm{s}$.
p-269.actionItem: Maanta haddii aad socdaal ku xanuunsato, halkii aad eegi lahayd muuqaalka dhow, fiiri buur fog ama cirka.

p-270.title: Tartanka xadhigga jiidashada, ma ahan miisaanka ee waa xoqidda cagta ayaa guulaysata
p-270.summary: Tartanka xadhigga jiidashada, xadhigga labada dhinac waxaa lagu jiidaa xoog isku mid ah, guusha-na waxaa go'aamisa xoqidda ugu badan ee dhulku cagta u hayo.
p-270.principle: Xoqidda taagan: $f \le \mu N$ ($N = mg$), xiisaha xadhigga labada dhinac waa isku mid (falka iyo falcelinta).
p-270.example: Haddii miisaanku yahay 70kg, dhul engegan $\mu = 0.8$ waa ugu badnaan ku dhawaad 550N, dhul simbiriirix leh $\mu = 0.4$ waa ku dhawaad 270N.
p-270.actionItem: Maanta haddii aad ciyaarto jiidasho ama ciyaar la mid ah, xidh kabo qabasho wanaagsan leh, jidhka dib u dhig oo hoos u dhig, laakiin ha ku duubin xadhigga gacantaada.

p-271.title: Haddii hilibka la gooyo kala bar, wuxuu bislaadaa 4 jeer ka dhakhso badan
p-271.summary: Haddii hilibka la jaro dhumuc kala bar ah, waqtiga kulaylku gaadho bartamaha wuxuu u yaraadaa ku dhawaad rubuc, shidaalkana waa la badbaadiyaa.
p-271.principle: Waqtiga kala firidhka kulaylka: $t \propto \dfrac{L^2}{\alpha}$ ($L$: dhumucda, $\alpha$: kala firidhka kulaylka).
p-271.example: Haddii qaybta hilibka dhumucdeedu yahay 6cm ay qaadato ku dhawaad 60 daqiiqo, 3cm waxaa lagu qiyaasi karaa $60 \times \left(\dfrac{3}{6}\right)^2 = 15$ daqiiqo.
p-271.actionItem: Maanta hilibka weyn u jar si khafiif ah oo dub, oo ku hubi heerkulka bartamaha inuu yahay ugu yaraan ku dhawaad 75°C adigoo adeegsanaya heer-kulaysle.

p-272.title: Bat-ka baseball-ka ku dhufo meesha sweet spot si gacantu ugu xanuunin
p-272.summary: Bat-ku wuxuu leeyahay xarun dhufasho (sweet spot) oo marka la dhuftaa gacanta ay ku dhacdo naxdin aad u yar.
p-272.principle: Masaafada xarunta dhufashada ee laga bilaabo dhinaca gacan-qabadka: $q = \dfrac{I}{m d}$ ($I$: wakhtiga ka-hortagga wareegga ee agagaarka dhidibka, $d$: masaafada ka socota dhidibka ilaa xarunta cuf-wadaaga).
p-272.example: Haddii usha isku-qaabka ah ee 0.84m laga qabto dhammaadka gacan-qabadka, $q = \dfrac{2}{3} L \approx 0.56\ \mathrm{m}$, bat-ka dhabta ah dhammaadkiisa ayaa ka culus, sidaas darteed booska wuu yara kala duwan yahay.
p-272.actionItem: Maanta tababarka dhufashada, ka feejignow inaad kubadda ku dhufato bartamaha bat-ka sweet spot-ka, ee ma ahan dhammaadka bat-ka.

p-273.title: Haddii xadhig tiir lagu duubo saddex jeer, xoogga ayaa yaraada
p-273.summary: Haddii xadhig tiir lagu duubo dhowr wareeg, xoqiddu way kordhaysaa, sidaas darteed xoog aad u yar ayaa lagu qaban karaa culays weyn.
p-273.example: Haddii $\mu = 0.3$, 3 wareeg ($\varphi = 6\pi \approx 18.85\ \mathrm{rad}$), $e^{5.65} \approx 285$ jeer, culeyska 1,000N waxaa lagu qabtaa ku dhawaad 3.5N (qiime fikir ah).
p-273.actionItem: Maanta marka aad alaab xidhayso, xadhigga tiirka ku duub 2~3 wareeg, laakiin ha ku duubin gacantaada ama jidhkaaga xadhigga, hana u isticmaalin culeysyada nolosha ku xiran.

p-274.title: Malabka iyo caanaha malabka marka la kululeeyo si fudud ayay u qul-qulaan
p-274.summary: Malabka iyo sharaabka malabku marka heerkulku kordho, qaro-weynaantu aad bay hoos ugu dhacdaa, sidaas darteed qaddarka ku hadha weelka wuu yaraadaa.
p-274.principle: Ku-tiirsanaanta heerkulka ee qaro-weynaanta (nooca Arrhenius): $\eta = A\,e^{E/(RT)}$.
p-274.example: Malabka qaro-weynaantiisu waxay ahayd ku dhawaad 10Pa·s 20°C, 40°C-na waxay noqotaa ku dhawaad 1~2Pa·s, taas oo ah 5~10 jeer ka khafiifsan.
p-274.actionItem: Maanta weelka malabka xidhan geli biyo diirran oo ku dhow 40°C 5 daqiiqo, kadibna isticmaal, laakiin ka fogow biyo karkaraya ama microwave.

p-275.title: Kimchi-ga la kaydiyo ku keydi sanduuq styrofoam ah oo balakoonka hadh leh ku yaal
p-275.summary: Styrofoam-ku kulaylka ma gudbiyo marka dhow, hadhkuna wuxuu xanibaa kulaylka shucaaca qorraxda. Marka labadan la isku daro, kimchi-gu wuxuu muddo dheer haystaa heerkul hoose oo joogto ah.
p-275.principle: Lumitaanka kulaylka hogaaminta waa $q=\frac{kA\Delta T}{L}$, hogaaminta kulaylka ee styrofoam-ku waa $k\approx0.035\ \mathrm{W/(m\cdot K)}$ oo ka hooseeya kan alwaaxda (ku dhawaad $0.12$). Qorraxda toosan ayaa dusha weelka ku kululeysa shucaac, sidaas darteed hadh ayaa loo baahan yahay.
p-275.example: Sanduuq dhumucdiisu $3\ \mathrm{cm}$, baaxaddiisuna $1\ \mathrm{m^2}$, marka farqiga heerkulka gudaha iyo dibadda uu yahay $10\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$, waa $q=0.035\times1\times10/0.03\approx12\ \mathrm{W}$. Sanduuq alwaax ah oo isla dhumuc ah wuxuu daadshaa ku dhawaad $40\ \mathrm{W}$, taas oo ka badan 3 jeer.
p-275.actionItem: Maanta weelka kimchi-ga geli sanduuqa styrofoam ee dhinaca hadhka leh ee balakoonka, meelaha bannaan ku buuxi wargeys, kadibna daboolka xidh.

p-276.title: Daloolka biyo-mareenka ee caleemo dhacay ka buuxaan, ka saar kahor intaan biyuhu daadan
p-276.summary: Haddii caleemo dhacay ay daboolaan baaxadda daloolka biyo-mareenka, xaddiga biyaha baxa xitaa roob isku mid ah aad buu hoos ugu dhacaa, taas oo keenta dib-u-qulqulid iyo daadad. Hal daqiiqo oo nadiifin ah kahor roobka waa ka-hortagga ugu jaban.
p-276.principle: Qulqulku waa $Q=Av$, sidaas darteed marka baaxadda wax-ku-ool ah ee biyuhu maraan $A$ yaraato, xaddiga biyaha baxa sidoo kale si saami ah ayuu u yaraadaa. Caleemuhu waxay xidhaan godadka shabakadda oo $A$ aad ayey u yareeyaan.
p-276.example: Baaxadda daloolka biyo-mareenka dhexroorkiisu yahay $10\ \mathrm{cm}$ waa ku dhawaad $79\ \mathrm{cm^2}$. Haddii caleemuhu daboolaan kala bar, $A\approx39\ \mathrm{cm^2}$, haddii xawaaruhu isku mid yahayna xaddiga biyaha baxa wuxuu hoos u dhacaa ku dhawaad $50\%$.
p-276.actionItem: Maanta caleemaha ku jira daboolka biyo-mareenka balakoonka, saqafka iyo hor-tagga guriga ka saar gacmo gacmo-gashan leh ama koronto.

p-277.title: 10 daqiiqo oo iftiin aroor ah waxay ka iftiin badan tahay nalka gudaha toban jeer
p-277.summary: Xitaa maalmaha daruuraha leh, dibadda aroorta waxay aad uga iftiin badan tahay nalka gudaha, iftiinkan xooggan-na wuxuu ka caawiyaa hagaajinta wareegga maalinlaha ah ee jidhka. Soo bixid gaaban oo aroor ah waa dawada iftiinka ugu fudud.
p-277.principle: Iftiinka (illuminance) waa xaddiga iftiinka ku dhaca hal cutub oo baaxad ah $E=\frac{\Phi}{A}$, cutubkiisuna waa lux ($\mathrm{lm/m^2}$). Dibadda maalin cad waa ku dhawaad $10{,}000\sim100{,}000\ \mathrm{lux}$, gudaha caadiga ahna waa $100\sim500\ \mathrm{lux}$.
p-277.example: Dibadda aroor cad oo ku dhow $10{,}000\ \mathrm{lux}$ waa ku dhawaad 20 jeer xafiiska $500\ \mathrm{lux}$, ku dhawaad 70 jeer qolka fadhiga $150\ \mathrm{lux}$. Xitaa maalmaha daruuraha leh badanaa waa $1{,}000\ \mathrm{lux}$ ama ka badan, sidaas darteed waa ka iftiin badan tahay gudaha.
p-277.actionItem: Maanta aroorta 10 daqiiqo ku soco dibadda, ee ma aha daaqadda ka eeg. Ha si toos ah u eegin qorraxda.

p-278.title: Buuxinta buuraha dayrta, qorraxdu way ka hore dhacdaa jadwalka sababo hadhka buurta
p-278.summary: Jadwalka qorrax-dhaca waxaa lagu saleeyay cirifka dhulka siman, sidaas darteed haddii dhanka galbeed ay ku taal buur-dheer, qorraxda waa la qarin doonaa si ka hore. Buuraha, wakhtiga qorraxdu gaadho buurta ayaa ah qorrax-dhaca dhabta ah.
p-278.principle: Haddii xagalka qarinta ee buurta galbeedku yahay $h$, wakhtiga qorraxdu ka dhacdo dhererkaas waa qorrax-dhaca dhabta ah, oo hadhku wuxuu hore u yimaadaa $\Delta t\approx\frac{h}{\omega}$. Dayrta ee ballaca dhexe, xawaaraha hoos-u-dhaca toosan ee qorraxdu waa ku dhawaad $\omega\approx12^\circ/\mathrm{h}$.
p-278.example: Haddii xagalka qarinta buurta galbeedku yahay $10^\circ$, $\Delta t\approx10^\circ/12^\circ\mathrm{/h}\approx50\ \mathrm{min}$ hadhku wuu ka hore yimaadaa. Haddii lagu daro wakhtiga mugdi noqoshada ka dib qorrax-dhaca, waqtiga ku haray dhaadhacidda wuxuu yaraadaa in ka badan 1 saac.
p-278.actionItem: Maanta qorshaha buuxinta, wakhtiga aad dhammaysanayso dhaadhacidda ka dhig 1.5~2 saacadood ka hor wakhtiga qorrax-dhaca ee jadwalka, oo gali lambad madaxa la xidho jawaankaaga.

p-279.title: Jaakadda baalasha ee kulaylka, u fiiri lambarka fill power iyo xaddiga buuxinta labadaba
p-279.summary: Fill power waa cabbirka sida wanaagsan ee baalasha jilicsan u bararaan oo hawada u qabtaan. Lambar sarreeya waa mid ka fudud isla kulayl, laakiin kulaylka guud waxaa go'aamiya xaddiga buuxinta oo ay la socoto.
p-279.principle: Fill power waa $\mathrm{FP}=\frac{V\,(\mathrm{in^3})}{m\,(\mathrm{oz})}$, taas oo ah mugga barara halkii cutub oo culeys ah. Kulaylku wuxuu ku xiran yahay dhumucda lakabka hawada taagan ee la qabtay ($k\approx0.026\ \mathrm{W/(m\cdot K)}$), sidaas darteed culeyska loo baahan yahay si loo buuxiyo isla mug waa $m\propto\frac{1}{\mathrm{FP}}$.
p-279.example: Si loo buuxiyo isla dhumuc, fill power 600 wuxuu u baahan yahay $100\ \mathrm{g}$, fill power 800-na wuxuu u baahan yahay $600/800\times100=75\ \mathrm{g}$. Haddii kulaylku isku mid yahay, waa ka fudud ku dhawaad $25\%$.
p-279.actionItem: Maanta markaad jaakad baalas ah iibsanayso, ka hubi calaamadda fill power iyo culeyska buuxinta (g) labadaba oo is barbar dhig.

p-280.title: Xisaabiyaha cadceedda wuxuu ka shaqeeyaa xitaa nalka gudaha
p-280.summary: Xisaabiyuhu wuxuu isticmaalaa dhowr microwatt oo keliya, sidaas darteed xitaa nalka gudaha oo aad uga daciifsan qorraxda ayaa u filan inuu shaqeeyo. Qodobka muhiimka ah ma aha xoogga iftiinka, ee waa in tamarta photon-ku ay dhaafto xadka.
p-280.principle: Tamarta photon waa $E=h\nu=\frac{hc}{\lambda}\approx\frac{1240\ \mathrm{eV\cdot nm}}{\lambda}$. Haddii ay ka weyn tahay bandgap-ka semiconductor-ka, elektaroonno ayaa la sii daayaa oo hadal ayaa socda, haddii iftiinku daciifo, hadalku keliya ayaa yaraada.
p-280.example: Photon-ka iftiinka muuqda ee mowjadda $550\ \mathrm{nm}$ wuxuu leeyahay $E\approx2.25\ \mathrm{eV}$, taas oo ka weyn bandgap-ka amorphous silicon ee ku dhow $1.7\ \mathrm{eV}$. Nalka gudaha $500\ \mathrm{lux}$ wuxuu yahay ku dhawaad $1/200$ qorraxda maalinta cad (ku dhawaad $100{,}000\ \mathrm{lux}$), laakiin wuu ku filan yahay xisaabiye dhowr $\mu\mathrm{W}$ ah.
p-280.actionItem: Maanta shid xisaabiyaha cadceedda nalka gudaha hoostiisa, kadibna gacanta ku dabool guddiga batteriga si aad u aragto in tirooyinku ay dabeeyaan.

p-281.title: Taleefannada OLED, habka madow (dark mode) ayaa batteriga badbaadiya
p-281.summary: OLED waxay pixel kasta u iftiimisaa naftiisa, sidaas darteed pixels madow ayaa aad u yar isticmaala tamar. Marka asalka shaashaddu mugdi badan yahay, tamarta shaashaddu way yaraataa.
p-281.principle: Awoodda shaashaddu waa wadarta awoodda pixel-ka $P=\sum_i P_i$, pixel madowna waa $P_i\approx0$. LCD-ga iftiinka dambe had iyo jeer shidan leeyahay, awoodduna waxay isku mid tahay iyadoo aan loo eegin waxa shaashadda ku jira, sidaas darteed wax saameyn ah ma leh.
p-281.example: Haddii loo qaato awoodda shaashaddu tahay asal cad $1.0\ \mathrm{W}$, asal madow $0.5\ \mathrm{W}$, 3 saacadood maalintii waxay badbaadisaa $0.5\ \mathrm{W}\times3\ \mathrm{h}=1.5\ \mathrm{Wh}$. Taasi waa ku dhawaad $10\%$ batteriga $15\ \mathrm{Wh}$.
p-281.actionItem: Maanta haddii taleefankaagu leeyahay shaashad OLED, ka shid habka madow (dark mode) goobaha. Haddii uu yahay taleefan LCD, saameyntu way yar tahay, sidaas darteed hoos u dhig dhalaalka.

p-282.title: Marka ceeryaamo lagu wado, adeegso iftiinka hoose iyo iftiinka ceeryaamada
p-282.summary: Haddii ceeryaamada lagu shido iftiinka sare, iftiinku wuxuu ku soo noqdaa dhibcaha biyaha, taas oo keenta inaadan hore wax arki karin. Iftiinka hoose ee hoos u iftiimiya iyo iftiinka ceeryaamadu waxay bixiyaan aragti ka wanaagsan.
p-282.principle: Dhibcaha ceeryaamada (dhexroor ku dhow $1\sim20\ \mu\mathrm{m}$) waxay u dhow yihiin dhererka mowjadda iftiinka, sidaas darteed kala-firidhka Mie ayaa iftiinka si xooggan u kala firdhiya dhinac walba, gaar ahaan hore iyo dambe. Iftiinku wuxuu hoos u dhacaa sida $I=I_0e^{-\beta x}$, iftiinka sare ee u dhow heerka indhaha ayaa dib u soo laabta oo abuura nal-xanuun.
p-282.example: Ceeryaamo aragga ku yahay $50\ \mathrm{m}$ gudahood, sida uu sheegayo sharciga taraafikada, xawaaraha ugu badan waa in ugu yaraan $50\%$ la yareeyaa, haddii wadadu leedahay xad $100\ \mathrm{km/h}$, waa $50\ \mathrm{km/h}$ ama ka yar.
p-282.actionItem: Maantadii ka bilaabo, maalmaha ceeryaamada leh shid iftiinka hoose iyo iftiinka ceeryaamada, dami iftiinka sare, oo masaafada gaadhiga hore ka dhig mid ka weyn sidii caadiga ahayd.

p-283.title: Iftiinka akhriska ka iftiimi dhinaca ka soo horjeedda gacanta aad ku qorto
p-283.summary: Iftiinku si toos ah ayuu u socdaa, sidaas darteed hadhka gacanta iyo qalinka ayaa xarfaha qarisa. Haddii aad hor-iyo-dhinaca ka soo horjeedda gacanta qorista ka iftiimiso, hadhku wuxuu aadaa gacanta gadaasheeda, sidaas darteed indhuhu way yar ku dadaalaan.
p-283.principle: Marka isha dhibcaha ah dhererkeedu yahay $H$, dhererka shayga $h$, masaafada toosan $d$, hadhku wuxuu shayga ka dambeeyaa $s=\frac{dh}{H-h}$. Haddii isha iftiinku tahay isla dhinaca gacanta qorista, hadhkan ayaa xarfaha dul dhaca.
p-283.example: Haddii dhererka nalka miiska $H=40\ \mathrm{cm}$, dhererka gacanta $h=3\ \mathrm{cm}$, masaafada toosan $d=30\ \mathrm{cm}$, hadh $s=\frac{30\times3}{37}\approx2.4\ \mathrm{cm}$ ayaa abuurma. Iftiinka akhriska waa caadi ahaan $300\sim500\ \mathrm{lux}$.
p-283.actionItem: Maanta, kuwa gacanta midig isticmaala nalka miiska dhig bidix hortiisa, kuwa gacanta bidix isticmaalana midig hortiisa.

p-284.title: Buur dhaadheer oo hoos u dhacsan, kor u fuul si siig-saag ah
p-284.summary: Haddii dhererka la fuulayo isku mid yahay, shaqadu isku mid bay tahay, laakiin haddii wadada si dhinac ah looga leexdo, xoogga talaabo kasta u baahan yahay wuu yaraadaa, neefsashaduna way yar tahay. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, masaafada socdaalku way dheeraataa.
p-284.principle: Shaqada loo baahan yahay jiirada korkeeda waa $W=mgh$, taas oo aan ku xirneyn wadada, laakiin xoogga jihada jiirada waa $F=mg\sin\theta=mg\frac{h}{L}$, sidaas darteed marka dhererka wadada $L$ kordho, wuu yaraadaa.
p-284.example: Qof miisaankiisu yahay $70\ \mathrm{kg}$ oo fuulaya $100\ \mathrm{m}$, $W\approx69\ \mathrm{kJ}$. Fuulid toos ah $30^\circ$ waa $F\approx343\ \mathrm{N}$ iyo $200\ \mathrm{m}$, siig-saag $15^\circ$ ah waa $F\approx178\ \mathrm{N}$ iyo ku dhawaad $386\ \mathrm{m}$.
p-284.actionItem: Maanta marka aad la kulanto qayb dhaadheer, dooro wadada siig-saagga ah ee dhex taal wadada dalxiiska, ha ka gudbin jid gaaban.

p-285.title: Taayirrada jiilaalka waa jilicsan yihiin marka heerkulku yahay 7°C ama ka yar
p-285.summary: Rubbadu marka qabowdo way adkaataa, qabashadu-na way yaraataa, laakiin taayirrada jiilaalku waxay isticmaalaan isku-darka jilicsan xitaa heerkul hoose. Xitaa baraf la'aan, haddii heerkulku yahay ku dhawaad 7°C, farqi ayaa jira.
p-285.principle: Rubbadu waxay haysataa jilicsanaan marka ay ka sarreyso heerkulka beddelka galaaska $T_g$, oo waxay adkaataa agagaarkiisa. Xoqiddu waa $F=\mu N$, masaafada joojintuna waa $d=\frac{v^2}{2\mu g}$, sidaas darteed marka $\mu$ hoos u dhaco, way dheeraataa.
p-285.example: Xawaare $80\ \mathrm{km/h}$ ($22.2\ \mathrm{m/s}$), haddii $\mu=0.8$ waa ku dhawaad $31\ \mathrm{m}$, haddii taayir qabow uu leeyahay $\mu=0.6$ waa ku dhawaad $42\ \mathrm{m}$. Tirooyinku waa fikrado sharaxaad ah.
p-285.actionItem: Maanta ka hubi saadaasha hawada in heerkulka maalinlaha ugu hooseeya uu sii socon doono ku dhawaad 7°C, oo qorsheyso beddelaadda taayirrada jiilaalka.

p-286.title: Nalka dareemaha dhaadheerka wuxuu arkaa shucaaca infrared ee kulaylka jidhka bini'aadamka
p-286.summary: Nalka dareemuhu wuxuu shidmaa marka uu dareemo isbeddelka infrared-ka ka yimaadda heerkulka jidhka marka qof dhaqaaqo. Wuxuu shidmaa wakhtiga loo baahan yahay oo keliya, sidaas darteed aad buu u yareeyaa awoodda nalka dhaadheerka.
p-286.principle: Mowjadda ugu sarreysa ee shucaaca shayga waa sharciga Wien $\lambda_{\max}=\frac{b}{T}$, $b\approx2898\ \mu\mathrm{m\cdot K}$. Haddii maqaarku yahay ku dhawaad $33\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ ($306\ \mathrm{K}$), $\lambda_{\max}\approx9.5\ \mu\mathrm{m}$, dareemaha PIR-na wuxuu arkaa isbeddelka infrared-kan.
p-286.example: LED dhaadheer $10\ \mathrm{W}$ ah haddii 24 saacadood la shido waa $240\ \mathrm{Wh}$. Haddii dareemuhu shido 2 saacadood maalintii oo awoodda sugitaanka dareemuhu tahay $0.5\ \mathrm{W}$, waa $20+12=32\ \mathrm{Wh}$, taas oo yaraynaysa ku dhawaad $87\%$.
p-286.actionItem: Maanta nalka dhaadheerka ama albaabka hore u beddel nal dareeme leh, ama waqtiga nalku shidan yahay ee dareemuhu ka dhigo 1~2 daqiiqo.

p-287.title: Qolka aan la isticmaalin albaabka u xidh oo yaree mugga la kululaynayo
p-287.summary: Haddii hawada la kululaynayo iyo baaxadda derbiga ay yaraadaan, kulayl yar ayaa loo baahan yahay si la gaaro isla heerkul. Laakiin haddii gabi ahaanba la go'doomiyo, qoyaanka xidhmo ayaa samaysmaya, sidaas darteed ilaali heerkulka ugu hooseeya.
p-287.principle: Kulaylka lagu kululeeyo hawada waa $Q=mc\Delta T$ oo $m=\rho V$, sidaas darteed wuxuu u dhigmaa mugga la kululaynayo $V$. Hawadu waa $\rho\approx1.2\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$, $c\approx1005\ \mathrm{J/(kg\cdot K)}$.
p-287.example: Si loo kordhiyo hawada qol madhan oo $25\ \mathrm{m^3}$ ah $5\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$, $Q=1.2\times25\times1005\times5\approx151\ \mathrm{kJ}\approx0.04\ \mathrm{kWh}$. Haddii lagu daro kulaylka derbiyada iyo alaabta iyo kulaylka si joogto ah u daadanaya, dhab ahaan waa dhowr jeer ka badan.
p-287.actionItem: Maanta albaabka qolka aan la isticmaalin xidh, oo valve-ka kululaynta qolkaas ha si buuxda u xidhin, ee ku dhig heerkulka ugu hooseeya.

p-288.title: Marka nalka hor-jeedka gaadhiga ka soo horjeedda ay indhaha qaboobiso, aragtida u jeedi dhinaca wadada midig
p-288.summary: Marka indhaha laga fogeeyo isha iftiinka, xaddiga iftiinka retina-ga gudaheeda lagu kala firdhiyay ee dabooli lahaa aad ayuu u yaraadaa. Haddii aragtida lagu hayo cidhifka wadada midig, nal-xanuunku wuu yaraadaa wadadana waa la arkaa.
p-288.principle: Iftiinka qarinta ee uu abuuro iftiinka kala firidhay ee indhaha ku jira waa qiyaas ahaan $L_v\approx\frac{10E}{\theta^2}$. Halkan $E$ waa iftiinka indhaha gaadha ($\mathrm{lux}$), $\theta$ waa xagalka u dhexeeya isha iftiinka iyo aragtida ($^\circ$).
p-288.example: Aragti $5^\circ$ ka fog isha iftiinka waa $L_v\propto1/25$, $10^\circ$ ka fog waa $1/100$, sidaas darteed iftiinka qarintu wuxuu yaraadaa $1/4$. Xubinta indhaha (pupil) sidoo kale way yaraataa marka iftiin badan yahay, taas oo wax badan ka caawisa.
p-288.actionItem: Maanta habeenkii marka aad la kulanto iftiinka sare ee ka soo horjeedda, indhaha ha xidhin, aragtida ku hay xariiqda cad ee wadada midig, oo yaree xawaaraha.

p-289.title: Sababta indhuhu u daalaan marka qol mugdi ah shaashadda keliya la shido
p-289.summary: Qolka mugdiga ah, indhaha pupil-kiisu waa weyn yahay, laakiin shaashaddu aad bay u iftiin badan tahay, sidaas darteed indhuhu waa inay si joogto ah u hagaajiyaan farqiga iftiinka. Haddii agagaarka si jilicsan loo iftiimiyo, farqigu wuu yaraadaa indhuhuna way raaxaystaan.
p-289.principle: Baaxadda pupil-ku waa $A=\frac{\pi d^2}{4}$, dhexroorkuna wuxuu u beddelmaa ku dhawaad $2\sim8\ \mathrm{mm}$, iftiinka retina-gu waa $E_r\propto L\,A$. Haddii saamiga iftiinka shaashadda iyo agagaarka uu weyn yahay, indhuhu si joogto ah ayay u beddelaan xaaladda la qabsiga.
p-289.example: Haddii dhexroorka pupil-ku ka weynaado $2\ \mathrm{mm}$ ilaa $8\ \mathrm{mm}$, baaxaddu waxay noqotaa 16 jeer. Haddii agagaarku yahay $0.5\ \mathrm{cd/m^2}$, shaashaddu-na $200\ \mathrm{cd/m^2}$, saamiga iftiinku waa $400:1$, taas oo aad uga weyn kan caadiga ah ee lagu taliyo ee ku dhow $3:1\sim10:1$.
p-289.actionItem: Maanta habeenkii markaad shaashadda eegayso, shid nal dhanka dambe ama nal miis yar si agagaarka si jilicsan loo iftiimiyo.

p-290.title: Xariiqda badbaadada ee saldhigga tareenka dhulka hoostiisa waxaa sabab u ah dabaysha tareenka
p-290.summary: Marka tareen dhakhso badan uu maro, hawada tareenka agtiisa waxay noqotaa mid dhakhso badan oo cadaadiskeedu hoos u dhaco, qofkuna wuxuu u soo jiidmi karaa dhanka tareenka. Istaag xariiqda badbaadada gadaasheeda waa u diyaargarowga ugu hubaal badan.
p-290.principle: Marka loo eego mabda'a Bernoulli $p+\frac12\rho v^2=\mathrm{const}$, marka xawaaraha hawada $v$ kordho, cadaadiska $p$ wuu hoos u dhacaa. Hoos u dhaca cadaadisku waa $\Delta p=\frac12\rho v^2$.
p-290.example: Haddii hawada tareenka agtiisa ay ku qulqusho $10\ \mathrm{m/s}$, $\Delta p=0.5\times1.2\times10^2=60\ \mathrm{Pa}$, baaxadda dhinaca jidhka ee $0.6\ \mathrm{m^2}$-na waxaa ku dhaca $F\approx36\ \mathrm{N}$ (ku dhawaad $3.7\ \mathrm{kgf}$). Dhab ahaan, qulqul-qalalan ayaa lagu daraa oo isbeddelaya.
p-290.actionItem: Maanta marka tareen soo galayo saldhigga, hal tallaabo oo dheeraad ah dib ugu noqo xariiqda badbaadada gadaasheeda.

p-291.title: Saxanka dubista madow wuxuu si dhakhso badan u dubaa
p-291.summary: Saxanka madow wuxuu nuugaa kulaylka shucaaca foornada oo badan, saxanka lacagta-midabka ahna wuxuu ka milicsadaa inta badan. Xitaa isla cunto-karinta, saldhiga ayaa si dhakhso badan u bunni noqda iyadoo ku xiran midabka saxanka.
p-291.principle: Tamarta shucaaca ee dusha nuugto waxay u dhigantaa nuugitaanka (=emissivity) $\varepsilon$, awoodda sii dayntuna waa $P=\varepsilon\sigma AT^4$. Dusha madow waa $\varepsilon\approx0.95$, aluminium dhalaalaya waa ku dhawaad $0.1$.
p-291.example: Deegaan shucaac isku mid ah, saxanka madow wuxuu nuugaa ku dhawaad $0.95/0.1\approx9$ jeer kulaylka shucaaca saxanka lacagta-midabka ah ee dhalaalaya. Sidaas darteed, saxanka madow badanaa waxaa lagu taliyaa in heerkulka foornada la hoos u dhigo ku dhawaad $10\sim15\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$.
p-291.actionItem: Maanta marka aad saxan madow ku dubayso, heerkulka foornada hoos u dhig $10\sim15\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ oo hore u hubi midabka dubista.

p-292.title: Hagaajinta heerkulka buufinta korontada waxaa sameeya bimetal
p-292.summary: Saxan khafiif ah oo laba biraha kala duwan lagu xidhay marka uu kulaylka helo wuxuu u foorarsadaa hal dhinac oo furaa oo xidhaa xiriirka korontada. Kani waa thermostat fudud oo korontada gooya heerkul go'an.
p-292.principle: Balaadhka toosan waa $\Delta L=\alpha L\Delta T$, farqiga isku-dhufashada balaadhka ee labada bir $\Delta\alpha$ ayaa saxanka foorarsada, dhaqaaqa dhammaadkuna waa $\delta=\frac{3\Delta\alpha\Delta T L^2}{4t}$ ($t$: dhumucda guud).
p-292.example: Haddii $L=50\ \mathrm{mm}$, $t=1\ \mathrm{mm}$, $\Delta\alpha=7\times10^{-6}\ \mathrm{/K}$, $\Delta T=40\ \mathrm{K}$, waxay dhaqaaqdaa $\delta\approx0.5\ \mathrm{mm}$ oo xiriirku go'aa.
p-292.actionItem: Maanta buufinta korontada ha laalin ama ha ururin, ee fur oo isticmaal, markaad seexanayso-na ku dhig heer hoose.

p-293.title: Isha kulaylka ee agagaarka thermostat-ka boilerku waxay khiyaaneysaa kululaynta
p-293.summary: Thermostat-ku wuxuu cabbiraa heerkulka meesha uu ku xidhan yahay oo keliya, wuxuuna shidaa oo demiyaa boilerka. Haddii agtiisa ay jirto kuuraha ama qorraxda, guriga oo dhan wuu ka qabow yahay heerka la dejiyay, haddii uu agteeda yahay derbi qabow-na kulayl xad-dhaaf ah ayaa dhaca.
p-293.principle: Thermostat-ku wuxuu shaqeeyaa marka heerkulka meesha dareemuhu ku yaal $T_{\mathrm{sensor}}$ uu ka hooseeyo qiimaha la dejiyay $T_{\mathrm{set}}$ keliya, sidaas darteed heerkulka celceliska qolka $T_{\mathrm{room}}=T_{\mathrm{sensor}}+\epsilon$ oo khaladka meeshu $\epsilon$ waa khaladka kululaynta.
p-293.example: Haddii isha kulaylka ee dareemaha agtiisa ay keento in uu ku akhriyo $23\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ halka celceliska qolku yahay $20\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$, xitaa heerka la dejiyay $22\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ boilerku wuu damaa, wuxuuna ka qabow yahay $2\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. Si ka duwan, kulayl xad-dhaaf ah $2\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ ah wuxuu kordhiyaa kharashka kululaynta ku dhawaad $14\%$ (qiyaas ahaan ku dhawaad $7\%$ 1°C kasta).
p-293.actionItem: Maanta ka saar kuuraha korontada, TV-ga, iyo isha kulaylka ee dhinaca daboolka qorraxda iyo alaabta agagaarka thermostat-ka.

p-294.title: Haddii dhinaca hal dhawaaqe polarity-ga la beddelo, codka hoose wuu lumaa
p-294.summary: Haddii + iyo − ee hal dhawaaqe la isku bedelo marka la xidhayo, labada dhawaaqe waxay ku dhawaaqaan wejiyo ka soo horjeedda, codka hoose ee mowjadda dheer waa la baabi'iyaa. Haddii codku khafiif yahay oo dareenka goobta uu yaab leeyahay, marka hore ka hubi polarity-ga.
p-294.principle: Labada mowjadood ee wejigoodu kala duwan yahay $\pi$ waxay samaysaa faragelin baabi'iya oo wadarta yaraata. Haddii dhererka mowjadda $\lambda=\frac{v}{f}$ uu aad uga weyn yahay masaafada u dhexeysa dhawaaqayaasha, meel kasta waa la baabi'iyaa ku dhawaad gabi ahaanba.
p-294.example: Dhererka mowjadda $100\ \mathrm{Hz}$ waa $\lambda=343/100=3.4\ \mathrm{m}$, taas oo ka weyn masaafada dhawaaqayaasha $2\ \mathrm{m}$, sidaas darteed bartamaha agtiisa aad ayuu u yaraadaa. $5\ \mathrm{kHz}$ waa $\lambda\approx6.9\ \mathrm{cm}$, sidaas darteed xitaa dhowr cm marka la dhaqaajiyo, xooggu kor iyo hoos ayuu u socdaa, waxayna u muuqataa sida codka hoose keliya uu lumay.
p-294.actionItem: Maanta hubi in sadarka dhawaaqaha + (casaan) uu ku xidhan yahay terminal-ka +, − (madow) terminal-ka −, labada dhawaaqe-na si isku mid ah.

p-295.title: Push-up jilibka ku taagan wuxuu yaraynayaa lever-ka jidhka
p-295.summary: Haddii jilibka dhulka la saaro, dhererka lever-ku wuu gaaban yahay, sidaas darteed culeyska gacmaha ku dhacaa wuu yaraadaa. Haddii push-up caadi ah ay adag tahay, waxaad ku bilaabi kartaa push-up jilibka adigoo isticmaalaya qaab sax ah.
p-295.principle: Haddii jidhka loo eego sida lever, isku-dheelitirka torque $F_{\mathrm{hand}}\,L=mg\,d$ ayaa siinaya xoogga gacantu qaadato $F_{\mathrm{hand}}=mg\frac{d}{L}$. Marka barta taageeradu ka guurto suulasha una guurto jilibka, $L$ iyo $d$ way is beddelaan, saamiga culeyskuna wuu yaraadaa.
p-295.example: Cilmi-baadhisyada, culeyska gacantu qaadato waxaa lagu sheegay ku dhawaad $64\%$ push-up caadi ah, ku dhawaad $49\%$ push-up jilibka. Haddii miisaanku yahay $70\ \mathrm{kg}$, waa ku dhawaad $45\ \mathrm{kg}$ iyo $34\ \mathrm{kg}$, taas oo ah ku dhawaad $23\%$ ka fudud.
p-295.actionItem: Maanta jidhka ku hay xariiq toosan (madax-dhex-jilib), oo samee 8 push-up oo jilibka ah 2 set. Haddii xanuun jiro, jooji.

p-296.title: Helista koonfurta adigoo isticmaalaya saacad analog ah iyo qorraxda
p-296.summary: Haddii gacanta saacadda ee gaaban loo jeediyo qorraxda, jihada u dhexeysa gacanta saacadda iyo 12-ka waa ku dhawaad koonfur. Waa habka qiyaasta ah ee aan qaboojin la'aan ku dhex socon karo woqooyiga hemisphere-ka.
p-296.principle: Qorraxdu waxay dhaqaaqdaa $\omega_\odot=15^\circ$ saacaddii, gacanta saacaddu-na waxay dhaqaaqdaa $\omega_h=30^\circ$ saacaddii. Sidaas darteed kala-bar xagalka gacanta saacadda $\frac{\omega_\odot}{\omega_h}=\frac12$ ayaa la mid ah isbeddelka jihada qorraxda, sidaas darteed xariiqda kala bar-dhigaysaa waxay tilmaamaysaa koonfur.
p-296.example: Saacadda 4-aad ee galabta, haddii gacanta saacadda (12-ka ilaa $120^\circ$) loo jeediyo qorraxda, kala-bar ahaan jihada saacadda $2$ waa koonfur. Kuuriya, xariiqda wakhtiga caadiga ah (bari $135^\circ$) iyo Seoul (ku dhawaad $127^\circ$) way kala duwan yihiin, sidaas darteed way ka duwan tahay wakhtiga qorraxda ku dhawaad $30$ daqiiqo, khaladkuna waa ku dhawaad $\pm15^\circ$.
p-296.actionItem: Maanta maalin cad dibadda ka qiyaas koonfurta saacad analog ah, oo is barbar dhig compass-ka taleefanka.

p-297.title: Muraayadda wax-weyneynta, marka darajada (D) ay weyn tahay, diiradda way gaabataa
p-297.summary: Darajada muraayadda wax-weyneynta waa is-beddelka dhererka diiradda, sidaas darteed lambar weyn waxay la macno tahay diiradda oo gaaban iyo weyneyn weyn. Marka weyneynta ay sarreyso, aragtida way cidhiidhi tahay, muraayaddana waa in loo dhowaysiiyaa indhaha iyo shayga.
p-297.principle: Awoodda muraayadda waa $D=\frac{1}{f}$ ($f$ cutubkiisu waa m, $D$ cutubkiisu waa diopter), weyneynta xagalka marka loo eego barta u dhow ee indhaha $25\ \mathrm{cm}$ waa $M\approx\frac{25\ \mathrm{cm}}{f}=\frac{D}{4}$.
p-297.example: $5\ \mathrm{D}$ waa $f=20\ \mathrm{cm}$ oo ah ku dhawaad $1.25$ jeer, $10\ \mathrm{D}$ waa $f=10\ \mathrm{cm}$ oo ah ku dhawaad $2.5$ jeer, $20\ \mathrm{D}$ waa $f=5\ \mathrm{cm}$ oo ah ku dhawaad $5$ jeer.
p-297.actionItem: Maanta marka aad muraayad wax-weyneyn iibsanayso, dooro darajada ku habboon isticmaalkaaga, oo ha dhigin meel qorraxdu ku dhacdo sababtoo ah iftiinka qorraxda ayaa isu geyn kara oo dab ka dhalin kara.

p-298.title: Hawo-bedelka kulaylka-beddelka wuxuu soo helaa kulaylka baxaya
p-298.summary: Waa qalab kulaylka gudaha ee marka hawada la bedelayo lagu lumi lahaa u gudbiya hawada qabow ee soo gelaysa. Hawada waa la beddelaa, laakiin qayb weyn oo kulaylka kululaynta ah ayaa la ilaaliyaa.
p-298.principle: Waxtarka soo kabashada kulaylku waa $\eta=\frac{T_{\mathrm{supply}}-T_{\mathrm{out}}}{T_{\mathrm{in}}-T_{\mathrm{out}}}$, lumitaanka kulaylka hawo-bedelkuna waa $P=\rho c\,\dot V\,\Delta T$ ($\rho c\approx1200\ \mathrm{J/(m^3\cdot K)}$).
p-298.example: Gudaha $22\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$, dibadda $0\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$, xaddiga hawo-bedelka $150\ \mathrm{m^3/h}$, lumitaanku waa $1200\times\frac{150}{3600}\times22\approx1100\ \mathrm{W}$. Haddii $\eta=70\%$, wuxuu hoos u dhacaa ku dhawaad $330\ \mathrm{W}$, hawada la gelinayana waa ku dhawaad $15.4\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$.
p-298.actionItem: Maanta haddii aad leedahay qalab kulaylka-beddelka (hawo-bedel), nadiifi shaandhada sida wakhtiga buugga tilmaamaha ku xusan.

p-299.title: Hal rug oo dhulka saaran wuxuu ku daraa hal lakab oo iska caabbin kulayl ah
p-299.summary: Rug-ku wuxuu u dhexeeyaa dhulka iyo cagta hal lakab oo kale oo go'doomin ah. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, haddii dhulku leeyahay kululayn, rug dhumuc weyn ayaa sidoo kale xanibi doona kulaylka qolka gelaya, sidaas darteed isticmaal mid khafiif ah.
p-299.principle: Haddii lakabyadu ku xiran yihiin taxan, iska caabbinta kulaylku waa $R=\sum\frac{L_i}{k_i}$, qulqulka kulaylkuna waa $q=\frac{\Delta T}{R}$. Marka lakab lagu daro, $R$ wuu weynaadaa oo $q$ wuu yaraadaa.
p-299.example: Rug dhumucdiisu tahay $1\ \mathrm{cm}$, $k\approx0.05\ \mathrm{W/(m\cdot K)}$ wuxuu leeyahay $R=0.2\ \mathrm{m^2K/W}$. Marka dhulku leeyahay $R=0.5$, $\Delta T=10\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$, $q=20\to14.3\ \mathrm{W/m^2}$, taas oo yaraynaysa ku dhawaad $29\%$.
p-299.actionItem: Maanta rug ku fidi meesha dhulka qabow ee inta badan lagu fadhiisto ama lagu taagan yahay, haddii qolku leeyahay kululayn dhulka ah dooro rug khafiif ah.

p-300.title: Haddii albaabku ku hoos dhaco, marka hore xoojiso boolalka hinge-ka sare
p-300.summary: Culeyska albaabku wuxuu jiidaa hinge-ka sare, hinge-ka hoose-na wuu riixaa, sidaas darteed boolalka sare ayaa marka hore dabacda. Inta badan, xoojinta boolalka hinge-ka sare oo keliya ayaa hagaajisa hoos u dhaca.
p-300.principle: Albaabka taagan wuxuu leeyahay isku-dheelitirka torque $\sum\tau=0$. Haddii culeyska $W$ uu ku dhaco bartamaha albaabka ($\frac{w}{2}$ ka fog hinge-ka), xoogga toosan masaafada hinge-yada $h$ waa $F=\frac{W\,w/2}{h}$.
p-300.example: Haddii cufnaanta albaabku tahay $20\ \mathrm{kg}$ ($W\approx196\ \mathrm{N}$), balaadhkiisu yahay $0.9\ \mathrm{m}$, masaafada hinge-yadu tahay $1.6\ \mathrm{m}$, $F=\frac{196\times0.45}{1.6}\approx55\ \mathrm{N}$ ayaa jiidaysa hinge-ka sare oo riixaysa kan hoose.
p-300.actionItem: Maanta albaabka furan ku hay, boolalka hinge-ka sare ku xoojiso screwdriver, daloolka daadanaya ku buuxi ilig-ka-saarka alwaax iyo shaabuunka alwaaxa, kadibna mar kale xoojiso.

p-301.title: Marka kursiga laga istaagayo, marka hore jidhka kore hore u janjeedh
p-301.summary: Xarunta cuf-wadaagga ee booska fadhiga waa cagaha ka dambeeya, sidaas darteed jidhka kore hore u janjeedhi oo xarunta cuf-wadaagga u rog cagaha dushooda si aad si yar u dadaali oo si deggan u istaagto.
p-301.principle: Si qofku u istaago, saadaalinta toosan ee xarunta cuf-wadaagga (COM) waa inay ku dhacdaa gudaha aagga taageerada ee cagaha samaysto. Haddii xarunta ay ka fog tahay cagaha si toos ah $x$, torque-ga cuf-wadaagga abuuro waa $\tau=mg\,x$.
p-301.example: Marka COM-ka booska fadhiga uu ka dambeeyo cagaha ku dhawaad $15\ \mathrm{cm}$, haddii jidhka kore hore loo janjeediyo ku dhawaad $30^\circ$, COM-ku wuxuu u soo socdaa ku dhawaad $10\ \mathrm{cm}$ hore, sidaas darteed $x$ inta badan way baabba'aa (qiime qiyaas ah).
p-301.actionItem: Maanta marka kursiga laga istaagayo, san u janjeedh dhanka suulasha cagaha, cagaha u soo jiid kursiga dhow, kadibna istaag. Haddii wareer soo noqnoqdo, la tasho khabiir.

p-302.title: Dhererka Xiddigta Woqooyi habeenka jiilaalka waxay la mid tahay ballaca aan ku joogo
p-302.summary: Xiddigta Woqooyi waxay u dhow tahay cirifka woqooyi ee samada, sidaas darteed dhererkeedu wuxuu ku dhow yahay ballaca goobjooge. Hal xiddigood ayaa lagu qiyaasi karaa ballaca goobta aan joogo.
p-302.principle: Xagalka dhererka cirifka woqooyi ee samada wuxuu la mid yahay ballaca goobjooge $\varphi$, Xiddigta Woqooyi-na waxay ka fog tahay cirifka ku dhawaad $0.7^\circ$, sidaas darteed $h_{\mathrm{Polaris}}\approx\varphi$.
p-302.example: Seoul (ku dhawaad $37.5^\circ$ N) Xiddigta Woqooyi waxay cirifka kor ka taagan tahay ku dhawaad $37.5^\circ$, Jeju (ku dhawaad $33.5^\circ$ N) waa ku dhawaad $33.5^\circ$. Hal feer oo gacanta la dheereeyay waa ku dhawaad $10^\circ$, sidaas darteed Seoul waa ku dhawaad 3.75 feer oo dherer ah.
p-302.actionItem: Maanta habeen cad ku hel Xiddigta Woqooyi adigoo isticmaalaya Ladle-ka Weyn ama W-ga Cassiopeia, oo ku cabbir dhererkeeda feer.

p-303.title: Sababta daboolka ka-hortagga milicsiga ee muraayadaha indhaha u leeyahay midab buluug ah
p-303.summary: Daboolka ka-hortagga milicsigu waa kan lagu sameeyay si iftiinka laga milicsado filim aad u khafiif ah ay isku baabi'iyaan. Waxaa loo hagaajiyay mowjadda cagaarka ee bartamaha, sidaas darteed buluug iyo casaan yar ayaa ka hadha midabka milicsiga.
p-303.principle: Haddii dhumucda filimka $d$ ay tahay $\frac{\lambda}{4n}$, farqiga wadada ee mowjadaha laga milicsaday dusha kore iyo hoose wuxuu noqdaa $\frac{\lambda}{2}$ oo waxay samaysaa faragelin baabi'iya. Tusmada jebinta filimka ee ku habboon waa $n_c=\sqrt{n_s}$.
p-303.example: Filim $\mathrm{MgF_2}$ ($n=1.38$) mowjadda $\lambda=550\ \mathrm{nm}$, $d=\frac{550}{4\times1.38}\approx100\ \mathrm{nm}$. Muraayad aan daboolka lahayn waxay ka milicsataa ku dhawaad $4\%$ dusha kasta, laakiin daboolka ayaa ku yareeya $1\%$ ama ka yar.
p-303.actionItem: Maanta muraayadaha indhaha ku nadiifi nadiifiye gaar ah iyo maro microfiber, oo ha ku xoqin maro qalalan ama biyo kulul.

p-304.title: Haddii xadhigga dallaadda ay khafiif tahay, dallaaddu way gaabisaa
p-304.summary: Xadhigga khafiifka ah iska caabbintiisu waa weyn tahay, sidaas darteed koronto-jiidku wuxuu ku dhacaa xadhigga oo wuxuu ku lumaa kulayl. Xitaa isla charger, xadhig dhumuc weyn wuxuu u gudbiyaa hadal badan.
p-304.principle: Hoos u dhaca korontadu waa $V=IR$, iska caabbinta xadhigguna waa $R=\frac{\rho L}{A}$. Awoodda xadhigga ku lumaysa kulayl waa $P=I^2R$.
p-304.example: Dallaadda $2\ \mathrm{A}$ ee adeegsaneysa xadhig naxaas ah $2\ \mathrm{m}$ oo laba-jeer ah ($\rho=1.7\times10^{-8}\ \Omega\mathrm{m}$), baaxadda goobta $0.08\ \mathrm{mm^2}$ (28 AWG) waa $R\approx0.42\ \Omega$ oo ah $0.84\ \mathrm{V}$, lumitaan $1.7\ \mathrm{W}$. $0.2\ \mathrm{mm^2}$ (24 AWG) waa $0.17\ \Omega$ oo ah $0.34\ \mathrm{V}$, $0.7\ \mathrm{W}$.
p-304.actionItem: Maanta xadhigga khafiifka ah ee dallaaddu ay gaabis tahay ama kulushahay u beddel xadhig dhumuc weyn oo hadalka qiimeysan lagu qoray.

p-305.title: Qaboojiyaha kimchi-ga ee daboolka leh, xitaa marka la furo, qabowgu wuu yar yahay daadsanaan
p-305.summary: Hawada qabow cufnaanteedu way weyn tahay, sidaas darteed hoos ayay u degdaa oo isu uruurisaa. Nooca kore laga furo, qabowgu wuxuu ku sii jiraa gudaha weelka, sidaas darteed xitaa marka la furo wuu yar yahay baxsada.
p-305.principle: Cufnaanta hawadu waa $\rho=\frac{p}{R_sT}$, marka heerkulku hooseeyo waa weyn tahay. Awoodda sabbaynta ee farqiga cufnaantu abuurto waa $\Delta\rho\,g\,V$, hawada qabowna hoos ayay si deggan u uruurtaa.
p-305.example: Hawada $4\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ waa ku dhawaad $1.27\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$, hawada $25\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ waa ku dhawaad $1.18\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$, taas oo ka culus ku dhawaad $7\%$. Qaboojiyaha albaabka dhinaca leh, qabowgan culus ayaa albaabka furan ka daadanaya.
p-305.actionItem: Maanta qaboojiyaha kimchi-ga hore u go'aami waxa aad ka soo qaadanayso, oo daboolka hal mar si gaaban u fur.

p-306.title: Dheri buuxa oo kar ku daadanaya, ushaan alwaax ah dul saar
p-306.summary: Marka xumbo ay ushaanka taabato oo dillaacdo, daadashadu inta badan way dib dhacdaa. Laakiin xal buuxa ma aha, sidaa darteed dabka yaree oo eeg waa aasaaska.
p-306.principle: Farqiga cadaadiska hal lakab xumbo waa isle'egta Laplace $\Delta p=\frac{2\gamma}{r}$ ($\gamma$: xoog-dusha sare, $r$: radius-ka qalooca). Marka filimka xumbada uu taabto dusha alwaax ee qallafsan, wuu khafiifaa oo si fudud ayuu u dillaacaa.
p-306.example: $100\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ ee biyaha $\gamma\approx0.059\ \mathrm{N/m}$, radius $1\ \mathrm{mm}$ xumbo markii yahay $\Delta p=\frac{2\times0.059}{0.001}\approx118\ \mathrm{Pa}$. Biyaha nuudhalka iyo pasta ee istaarijka badan waxay leeyihiin filim xumbo oo adag.
p-306.actionItem: Maanta marka aad nuudhal karineyso, ushaan alwaax ah oo qalalan ka dul saar afka dheriga, dabka na dhexdhexaad ku dhig. Ushaanku dabka yuusan taabanin.

p-307.title: Dabayl 1m/s kasta oo kordha, heerkulka la dareemo wuxuu hoos u dhacaa qiyaastii 1°C
p-307.summary: Marka dabaylu dhacdo, lakabka hawada diirran ee maqaarka u dhow wuu baxaa, sidaa darteed isla heerkul ayaa la dareemaa mid ka qabow. Xilliga qabowga, dabayl iyo heerkul labadaba eeg marka aad dharka dooranayso.
p-307.principle: Luminta kulaylka ee convection-ka xoogga leh waa $q=h(v)\,A\,(T_{\mathrm{skin}}-T_{\mathrm{air}})$ oo xawaaraha dabaylka $v$ marka uu weynaado, $h$ wuu kordhaa. Tusmada heerkulka la dareemo waa $T_{wc}=13.12+0.6215T-11.37v^{0.16}+0.3965Tv^{0.16}$ ($v$: $\mathrm{km/h}$).
p-307.example: Heerkul $0\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ iyo xawaare dabayl $1.4\ \mathrm{m/s}$ ($5\ \mathrm{km/h}$) waa qiyaastii $-1.6\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$, $5\ \mathrm{m/s}$ ($18\ \mathrm{km/h}$) waa qiyaastii $-4.9\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$, xawaaraha dabayl qiyaastii $3.6\ \mathrm{m/s}$ kordhitaan, qiyaastii $3.3\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ hoos ayay u dhacdaa.
p-307.actionItem: Maanta maalmaha dabayl badan, jaakad dabayl iyo xariir-qoor ku dabool maqaarka muuqda.

p-308.title: Wareegga dayaxa wuxuu noqon karaa calaamad roob
p-308.summary: Wareegga dayaxa waa giraan ay samaysay baraf-crystal ee daruuraha sare ee iftiinka dayaxa jabiya. Daruurahani badanaa waxay muuqdaan marka hore soo dhawaanayso, sidaa darteed suurtogalnimada roobku way kordhaa laakiin hubaal ma aha.
p-308.principle: Xagalka ugu yar ee prism ee baraf-crystal lix-geesood ahi waa $D_{\min}=2\arcsin\left(n\sin30^\circ\right)-60^\circ$. Baraf $n\approx1.31$ marka yahay $D_{\min}\approx22^\circ$ dayaxa agtiisa giraan $22^\circ$ ayaa samaysma.
p-308.example: $n=1.31$ ka $\arcsin(0.655)\approx40.9^\circ$ waa sababta $D_{\min}\approx2\times40.9-60\approx21.8^\circ$. Gacan fidsan oo gacan-dhammaystiran ayaa qiyaastii $20^\circ$, sidaa darteed dayaxa ilaa giraanka waa qiyaas gacan oo keliya.
